本周核心方向（ML × ferro / 凝聚态）

20 篇

本周“新材料”主线最实在的进展，是围绕铁电钙钛矿与高熵氧化物把可训练数据的物理底座做实了：C09x-PBEc 把 C09 交换与 PBE 相关结合，在 PbTiO3 和 BaTiO3 上同时压住晶格常数与自发极化的系统性高估，目标直指 MLIP 训练所依赖的 DFT 标准。高熵钙钛矿氧化物方面，ordered-to-disordered 迁移学习表明形成能可从有序钙钛矿稳健迁移，但 HOMO-LUMO gap 对局域化学环境更敏感，必须补少量 HEPO 数据并引入三体几何信息才明显改善。材料发现层面，EMT 沸石仅用 174 次合成尝试就筛出 6 组条件、其中 5 组成功结晶，SPE 溶剂筛选则从约 1 万个 DFT 溶剂里识别出 N-methoxy-N-methyl-2,2,2-trifluoroacetamide 等候选并在 PVDF-HFP 基体中验证了电化学收益。n“新方法”主线集中在把物理约束塞进 ML：PI-HNO 用局部递归分支、Preisach 风格全局分支和 B-H 能量一致性正则，在 MagNetX 的 14 种铁氧体上实现少参数预测瞬态磁化；硬磁论文则用 12012 条微磁模拟训练回归模型，并用符号回归恢复 Kronmüller 形式及新闭式矫顽场表达式。4D-STEM 稀疏应变重建把弹性平衡与 Saint-Venant 相容性写进 PINN 损失，低采样下比压缩感知和 GPR 更稳；而预训练 MACE 表征被直接拿来当材料生成的粗粒化坐标，用于统一评估质量与新颖性。n“新现象”主线里，二维 Hubbard 的 transformer 神经网络量子态把猝变后的双占据数动力学推到更长时间尺度，弱到中等 U 快速热化，而超过临界 U 后出现预热化平台；Krylov/Lanczos 系数的 transformer 外推则把复杂量子与经典混沌系统的长程序…

  1. 01
    An Exchange-Correlation Functional for Fast and Accurate Modeling of Ferroelectric Perovskites
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.04806v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们提出一种新型交换-相关泛函 C09x-PBEc，它将 C09 交换与 PBE 相关相结合，能够在保留 GGA 泛函计算效率的同时，准确模拟钙钛矿的铁电性质。随着人们日益关注开发机器学习原子间势（MLIP）以模拟具有技术意义的大规模铁电体系，审视用于计算 MLIP 训练所依据的力、能量和应力的密度泛函理论交换-相关泛函显得尤为重要。以典型铁电体钛酸铅 PbTiO3 和钛酸钡 BaTiO3 为例，我们表明，许多广泛使用的泛函往往会高估其晶格常数和自发极化。相较之下，采用 C09 交换的非局域范德华泛函能够与实验更准确地吻合这些性质，但其计算开销大于例如 GGA。我们表明，C09x-PBEc 将 C09 交换所提供的精度与 GGA 的计算可负担性结合起来，使其成为用于铁电钙钛矿 MLIP 训练的极佳候选。我们还证明，使用 C09x-PBEc 训练的 MLIP 能够准确再现实验所测得的 PbTiO3 铁电-顺电相变温度，相较于使用 GGA 训练的 MLIP 有显著改进。

    📐 方法要点：用 C09 交换 + PBE 相关构造 GGA 泛函 C09x-PBEc，保持 GGA 计算量。重点在 PbTiO3、BaTiO3 上比较晶格常数、极化和能量面。

    🔗 相关工作关联：呼应铁电 MLIP 训练对 DFT 标签精度的要求，也接近含非局域交换的 vdW 泛函思路。不同点是把精度与可负担性一起保住，而不是只追求更复杂泛函。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可直接把 C09x-PBEc 作为铁电 MLIP 的参考标签源。优先在相变路径、极化翻转与应力响应上做一致性基准。

  2. 02
    超越 Stoner-Wohlfarth：硬磁性质的机器学习模型与符号回归
    Beyond Stoner-Wohlfarth: Machine-Learning Models and Symbolic Regression of Hard-Magnet Properties
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：从磁晶粒的磁滞回线外禀性质，即矫顽场、剩余磁化强度和最大磁能积，出发，根据其内禀微磁参数进行预测，是永磁体建模中的核心问题。已有解析模型能够提供有用估计，但通常忽略非均匀磁化过程，而直接微磁模拟的计算成本很高。在本工作中，我们在 12012 次理想化立方晶粒的微磁模拟数据上训练机器学习模型，涵盖饱和磁化强度、交换常数和单轴各向异性常数的宽广范围。在相同的保留测试数据上与解析模型进行基准比较时，机器学习模型对全部三种外禀性质的预测误差显著更低。符号回归恢复了矫顽场的 Kronmüller 形式，其中有效退磁因子依赖于材料，并找到了剩磁和最大磁能积的新闭式表达式。每条规律最多包含两个拟合常数，但其精度接近机器学习模型。我们还研究了从三种外禀性质恢复内禀参数的反问题。饱和磁化强度和各向异性常数能够被准确恢复，而交换常数不能，因为它对外禀性质的影响很弱。训练好的模型通过 mammos-ai Python 软件包发布，使得数千组候选参数可以在数秒内完成筛选，而直接微磁模拟则需要数小时或数天。

    📐 方法要点：用 12012 次立方磁晶粒微磁模拟训练回归模型，输入内禀参数预测矫顽场、剩磁和最大磁能积。再用符号回归提取闭式公式。

    🔗 相关工作关联：与 Stoner-Wohlfarth 解析框架同属硬磁建模，但把单一解析式扩展到数据驱动与可解释表达式。也呼应 Kronmüller 矫顽场机理。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可先用 ML 做快速筛选，再用符号回归压缩成可发表的经验公式。反演内禀参数时应优先锁定 Ms 和各向异性常数。

    阅读原文 ↗
  3. 03
    用于功率磁性器件瞬态磁化预测的物理信息混合神经算子
    A Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator for Transient Magnetization Prediction in Power Magnetics
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.02965v1 公告类型：交叉。高频、高功率密度变换器中的磁性元件越来越多地由具有快速跃迁、小回线运行、直流偏置和温度变化的非正弦磁通密度波形驱动。在这些条件下，稳态磁芯损耗公式和单值材料曲线无法充分捕捉瞬态磁化响应。本文提出物理信息混合神经算子（PI-HNO），这是一种紧凑的材料专用神经模型，带有用于面向磁芯损耗的瞬态磁化预测的 B-H 能量一致性正则化。给定测得的 B(t)-H(t) 历史、预测区间内的输入 B(t) 序列以及工作条件信息，PI-HNO 预测 H(t) 序列及相应重构的 B-H 轨迹。该模型整合了一个用于边界状态表征和速率相关响应演化的局部递归分支，以及一个受 Preisach 启发、用于提取波形级磁滞上下文的全局分支。在 MagNetX 瞬态数据库上使用针对 14 种铁氧体材料的材料专用模型进行评估表明，PI-HNO 在序列精度与 B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性之间实现了紧凑折中；每个模型仅使用 4777 个可训练参数时，B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性误差的均值和第 95 百分位数分别为 1.92% 和 7.60%。消融研究进一步表明，局部、全局和能量感知正则化组件对瞬态磁化预测提供了不同的贡献。

    📐 方法要点：PI-HNO 采用局部递归分支 + Preisach 启发全局分支，并加入 B-H 能量一致性正则。输入磁通历史和工况，输出 H(t) 与磁滞轨迹。

    🔗 相关工作关联：和传统 Preisach/ Jiles-Atherton 模型相比，它保留磁滞物理又能适应非正弦、直流偏置与温度变化。目标更偏向功率磁性器件而非纯材料本构拟合。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可用于芯损仿真前的轻量级瞬态代理模型。训练时应把能量闭合当作硬约束，否则时序预测再准也会破坏损耗估计。

    阅读原文 ↗
  4. 04
    神经网络的纠缠能力
    Entangling power of neural networks
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：表征子系统之间相关性的复杂程度，是信息理论、机器学习和科学中的一项基础任务。在量子物理中，神经网络已越来越多地用于学习波函数。本文引入了编码器-解码器神经网络的纠缠能力，用以量化其在子系统之间生成纠缠的能力，该能力取决于潜在空间维度 K 以及解码器的复杂性类别。我们精确计算了作用于 K 维潜在空间的 p 次多项式解码器的这一数量。我们的结果确立了神经网络在适度资源下的指数级纠缠能力。更广泛地说，我们的工作提供了一个用于分析机器学习中相关性的框架，该框架推广了纠缠理论中 Schmidt 秩的概念。

    📐 方法要点：定义编码器-解码器网络的纠缠能力，对 p 次多项式解码器可精确计算。分析潜在维度 K 与多项式阶数对纠缠/相关生成能力的标度。

    🔗 相关工作关联：把量子 Schmidt 秩类比引入机器学习相关性分析，和一般表征容量指标不同。它更像是对网络可生成复杂子系统相关性的几何化刻画。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可用来比较不同生成式网络的结构表达力，而不只看参数量。做多体态或相关结构建模时，可先检查模型的纠缠能力是否足够。

    阅读原文 ↗
  5. 05
    超越电子：近场极限下的辐射热计算与神经网络
    Beyond Electrons: Radiative Thermal Computing and Neural Networks at the Near-Field Limit
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：我们提出并分析了一种可编程的近场辐射热网络，该网络通过热交换来模拟卷积和循环操作。通过集成由 VO2 和 GST 等相变材料组成的辐射热二极管和晶体管，我们构建了两种基本架构：热卷积神经网络（T-CNN）和热循环神经网络（T-RNN）。T-CNN 通过依赖温度的发射率调制来执行空间模式识别，其中每个门都作为可调谐的辐射滤波器，用于放大或抑制局域热通量。该系统可通过 VO2/GST 中的门温度分布进行外部编程，从而实现加权求和和非线性激活；滞后相变提供了依赖状态的响应，可用于记忆。T-RNN 将这一功能扩展到时间维度，嵌入辐射反馈和滞后相变，以实现记忆和序列推理。这些系统共同表现出三态逻辑行为、辐射增益和非易失热存储，这是物理学习的关键属性。每个逻辑节点都不依赖电荷载流子或电路运行，而仅依赖纳米尺度表面之间的近场光子隧穿。由此形成的框架使卷积、记忆保持和反馈学习能够在一种非接触、节能的平台中直接实现。本研究建立了热深度学习的首个辐射实现，揭示了一种新的计算范式，其中温度场作为智能的载体，将热传递、记忆和自适应推理统一于一个非电子系统之中。

    📐 方法要点：构建可编程近场辐射热网络，用 VO2、GST 等相变材料实现热二极管和晶体管。以温度场编码卷积、循环与三态逻辑。

    🔗 相关工作关联：延续热计算和非电子计算路线，但把近场辐射与相变器件结合得更系统。与传统神经形态硬件不同，这里信息载体是热流而非电荷。

    💡 对你方向的启示：适合做极低功耗、慢时标推理原型。若要落地，需要优先设计可复位的相变单元和稳定的温度读出协议。

    阅读原文 ↗
  6. 06
    主动学习引导的设计空间细化：用于材料发现的可扩展多目标贝叶斯优化
    Active Learning Guided Design Space Refinement for Scalable Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：先进材料发现越来越依赖机器学习和贝叶斯优化，以在有限的评估预算下探索大规模离散设计空间。然而，随着候选空间增大，传统贝叶斯优化（BO）可能变得低效，在到达信息丰富区域之前先评估低价值区域。我们提出一种将主动学习（AL）引导的自适应搜索空间细化框架与多目标BO相结合的方法，以在保留帕累托相关区域的同时加速材料优化。我们在共价有机框架中的CH4/N2分离，以及涉及材料方向应力分量和厚度目标的压力容器设计问题上评估了该方法。结果表明，AL引导的细化可将候选空间缩小约一半，同时保留原始超体积的99%以上。缩减空间的策略改善了BO的早期收敛和累积帕累托前沿发现能力，展示了其在受约束的自主材料发现场景中进行大规模材料优化的高效性。

    📐 方法要点：把主动学习用于设计空间自适应细化，再接多目标贝叶斯优化。核心是先缩小高价值区域，再在保留帕累托前沿的前提下继续搜索。

    🔗 相关工作关联：和标准 BO 相比，重点不是换 surrogate，而是解决大离散空间里“先扫低价值区”的低效问题。更适合高成本材料发现。

    💡 对你方向的启示：当候选空间很大时，可先做主动收缩再做 BO。多目标任务中应把帕累托相关区域显式保留，避免过早丢解。

    阅读原文 ↗
  7. 07
    含可见单元和隐单元的量子玻尔兹曼机学习基础
    Fundamentals of quantum Boltzmann machine learning with visible and hidden units
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：经典玻尔兹曼机的一个主要应用是生成建模，其目标是调节模型分布的参数，使其尽可能逼近目标分布。训练依赖于估计目标分布与模型分布之间相对熵的梯度；当经典玻尔兹曼机同时具有可见单元和隐单元时，这一任务已被很好地理解。多年来，将这一结果推广到同时具有可见单元和隐单元的量子玻尔兹曼机上的量子态学习，一直是一个障碍。在本文中，我推导了目标量子态与量子玻尔兹曼机可见单元约化态之间量子相对熵梯度的解析表达式。关键的是，该表达式适合在量子计算机上估计，因为它涉及由模流生成的幺正旋转，令人联想到我先前关于旋转Petz恢复映射的工作中的那些幺正旋转。这就导出了在这一设定下的一个量子梯度估计算法。随后我将该设定具体化为量子可见单元和经典隐单元，以及相反的情形；我也给出了这些情形下梯度的解析表达式，并提供了估计它们的量子算法。最后，我用Petz-Tsallis相对熵替代量子相对熵作为目标函数；在这里，我利用矩阵幂函数导数公式的一个独立推导，发展了梯度的解析表达式，并勾勒出一个用于估计该梯度的量子算法，该推导同样涉及由模流生成的幺正旋转。总之，本文标示了在用于生成建模和量子态学习的、具有可见单元和隐单元的量子玻尔兹曼机训练方面的进展。

    📐 方法要点：研究可见/隐单元量子玻尔兹曼机的学习基础，推导量子相对熵梯度的解析式。还给出量子机上可估计的梯度算法，并讨论 Petz-Tsallis 情形。

    🔗 相关工作关联：延续 QBM 的统计物理建模传统，但把训练目标直接写成约化态学习。比经典 BM 更接近量子态制备与量子生成模型。

    💡 对你方向的启示：若做量子生成模型，可直接用这些梯度公式设计可实现的训练循环。可见/隐单元的量子-经典混搭结构也值得优先测试。

    阅读原文 ↗
  8. 08
    Machine Learning Bandgap Prediction of Nanoporous Graphenes with Water
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.03680v1 公告类型：新摘要：受限于纳米结构内部或表面的水的结构与动力学行为，是从生物学到新兴电子学（如碳纳米结构）等众多领域中的核心问题。具有特定拓扑结构、含有周期性纳米级孔洞的纳米孔石墨烯（NPG）已成为碳基纳米电子学中一种很有前景的材料；然而，其与环境水的相互作用仍缺乏充分认识。本文结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、从头算分子动力学（AIMD）以及可解释机器学习（ML），揭示了水如何调控 NPG 中的量子输运。根据局域水合结构的不同，NPG 及氮掺杂杂化（h-NPG）体系的带隙变化可超过两倍。为揭示其内在机制，我们构建了基于原子位置平滑重叠（SOAP）的黑箱模型和融入物理信息的灰箱机器学习模型。高斯过程回归模型在接近 DFT 精度的同时，实现了物理可解释性。分析表明，水偶极取向、水-基底距离、水的几何中心以及按条带分辨的偶极矩，是控制 NPG 与 h-NPG 体系带隙调制的主导因素。

    📐 方法要点：结合 DFT、AIMD 与可解释 ML 研究 NPG/h-NPG 与水的带隙调控。用 SOAP 黑箱模型和灰箱高斯过程回归，把局域水合结构映射到 bandgap。

    🔗 相关工作关联：与界面/溶剂调控输运的工作一致，但这里把水偶极取向和水-基底距离直接做成主要解释变量。强调了拓扑孔洞碳材料的环境敏感性。

    💡 对你方向的启示：做纳米孔碳材料器件时，环境水不应当当噪声处理，而应纳入结构特征。可先从偶极取向和局域几何做可解释特征工程。

    🔗 相关工作关联：呼应可转移 MLIP 的核心问题，但对象从晶体扩展到缠结聚合物。比只在单尺度数据上拟合更强调构型覆盖与外推。

    📐 方法要点：把弹性平衡和 Saint-Venant 相容性通过自动微分写进 PINN 损失，用于稀疏 4D-STEM 应变场重建。实验对象是 PbGeSnSe1.5Te1.5。

    📐 方法要点：用含 transformer 的神经网络量子态做含时变分蒙特卡罗，研究二维 Hubbard 模型 U 猝变后的双占据演化。时间演化推到传统方法难以到达的长时区间。

    Krylov 空间中的注意力：基于 Transformer 的 Lanczos 系数外推
    Attention in Krylov Space: Transformer-Based Extrapolation of Lanczos Coefficients
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：普适算符增长假说通过 Lanczos 系数来表述算符的时间演化。然而在实践中，数值不稳定性和内存成本限制了能够被精确计算的系数数量。为应对这些挑战，标准方法依赖于将早期系数拟合到渐近形式，但这种程序可能遗漏系数中次主导的、依赖历史的结构，而这些结构随后会影响重构的观测量。在这项工作中，我们将 Lanczos 系数视为因果时间序列，并引入一种基于 transformer 的模型，从短前缀自回归地预测未来的 Lanczos 系数。对于经典和量子混沌系统，我们的模型在系数外推和物理观测量重构方面均优于渐近拟合，并实现了误差降低一个数量级。该模型还能够在可积区域中准确外推系数，而在那里不存在普适的渐近拟合。值得注意的是，我们的模型可以跨系统尺寸迁移：它可以在较小系统上训练，然后无需重新训练即可用于在较大系统上外推系数。通过探查学习到的注意力模式并进行有针对性的注意力消融，我们识别出系数历史中对准确预测最有影响的部分。我们的结果表明，现代序列模型可以作为实用替代工具，用于探测 Krylov 空间深处的算符动力学，在那里蛮力 Lanczos 迭代在计算上可能过于昂贵。

    📐 方法要点：把 Lanczos 系数视为因果序列，用 transformer 自回归外推后续系数。再由系数重构物理观测量，并分析注意力对应的关键历史片段。

    🔗 相关工作关联：与 Krylov 动力学和渐近拟合路线相比，它更适合缺少统一渐近式的系统。对经典与量子混沌都有效，且可跨尺寸迁移。

    💡 对你方向的启示：做长时动力学时，可先预测 Lanczos 系数再重建观测量。注意力图还能反向告诉你哪些早期系数最值得精确计算。

01

本周总览#

先把握一周的主线，再进入交叉重点与专题全文速览。

整体概览

本周磁性与铁电方向的核心集中在交替磁性、拓扑磁体、范德华多铁性和铁电功能泛函。Nb3Cl8、RuO2、MnBi2Te4、CrSBr、Mn3Si2Te6 等体系把极化、Berry 曲率、自旋劈裂、轨道电流和界面态联系到可测输运或光谱信号。AI/ML 方向中，材料势函数、神经量子态、物理信息神经网络和生成式逆设计继续向真实材料体系嵌入，覆盖铁电钙钛矿、Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型、聚合物、合金和电池电解质。Nature/Science 系列亮点偏向“可观测新相”和“可迁移方法”，arXiv 则给出大量对称性框架、高通量筛选和机器学习工作流。

趋势观察

交替磁性从RuO2、CrSb、KV2Se2O、α-MnTe扩展到二维CrO、Ta2TeSeO和光子晶体，核心变量是自旋空间群、表面破缺、Néel矢量取向和非相对论自旋劈裂。范德华磁体的控制手段更偏向局域可调：CrSBr用光场切换磁序，Mn3Si2Te6用应变调轨道电流畴，MnBi2Te4用缺陷或邻近磁性改变拓扑表面态。铁电方向的重点不是单纯寻找新极化，而是把极化反转映射到能带、非线性光学和MLIP训练数据质量；PbTiO3、BaTiO3、LiNbO3/MoS2和滑移铁电多层是代表体系。AI/ML材料工作继续从“预测性质”转向“可执行工作流”，包括C09x-PBEc训练基准、EFR-GNN电场驱动MD、1T-TaS2纳秒级ML力场动力学和高熵钙钛矿迁移学习。神经量子态在Hofstadter-Hubbard、自旋电荷分离和二维Hubbard热化中承担大体系量子模拟角色，但双电子束缚能、热化平台和有限尺寸外推仍需谨慎区分。

后续展望

下一步最值得跟进的是交替磁性表面态、RuO2轨道/自旋霍尔分量和CrSBr手性光伏效应的同一样品多探针交叉验证。铁电MLIP应优先比较C09x-PBEc、SCAN、vdW-DF在畴壁、相变温度和应变响应上的训练偏差。AI生成式材料设计需要把真实实验闭环、失败样本和不确定性审计纳入筛选，否则高R2代理模型仍可能在最优候选处系统性过估。

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.04806v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们提出一种新型交换-相关泛函 C09x-PBEc，它将 C09 交换与 PBE 相关相结合，能够在保留 GGA 泛函计算效率的同时，准确模拟钙钛矿的铁电性质。随着人们日益关注开发机器学习原子间势（MLIP）以模拟具有技术意义的大规模铁电体系，审视用于计算 MLIP 训练所依据的力、能量和应力的密度泛函理论交换-相关泛函显得尤为重要。以典型铁电体钛酸铅 PbTiO3 和钛酸钡 BaTiO3 为例，我们表明，许多广泛使用的泛函往往会高估其晶格常数和自发极化。相较之下，采用 C09 交换的非局域范德华泛函能够与实验更准确地吻合这些性质，但其计算开销大于例如 GGA。我们表明，C09x-PBEc 将 C09 交换所提供的精度与 GGA 的计算可负担性结合起来，使其成为用于铁电钙钛矿 MLIP 训练的极佳候选。我们还证明，使用 C09x-PBEc 训练的 MLIP 能够准确再现实验所测得的 PbTiO3 铁电-顺电相变温度，相较于使用 GGA 训练的 MLIP 有显著改进。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.04806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a novel exchange correlation functional, C09x-PBEc, which combines C09 exchange with PBE correlation, to accurately model the ferroelectric properties of perovskites while retaining the computational efficiency of GGA functionals. With a growing interest in developing machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to model large-scale ferroelectric systems of technological relevance, it is important to scrutinise the density functional theory exchange-correlation functionals which are used to compute the forces, energies and stresses the MLIP is trained on. Using the example of the prototypical ferroelectrics lead titanate, PbTiO3, and barium titanate, BaTiO3 we show that many widely used functionals tend to overestimate their lattice constants and spontaneous polarization. Conversely, non-local van der Waals functionals with C09 exchange accurately capture these properties compared to experiment, but with a larger computational overhead than, for example, GGA. We show that C09x-PBEc combines the accuracy provided by the C09 exchange with the computational affordability of GGA, making it an excellent candidate to be used in the training of MLIPs for ferroelectric perovskites. We also demonstrate that an MLIP trained using C09x-PBEc accurately reproduces the ferroelectric-to-paraelectric phase transition temperature of PbTiO3 with respect to experiment, showing a marked improvement on MLIPs trained using GGA.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.02727v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：最近在莫尔材料中的实验使多种奇异量子相的实现成为可能。在这一背景下，Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型被提出为可能承载手性自旋液的体系。与此同时，二维多体费米子体系的计算方法最近取得了显著进展，这使得在真正二维几何中对这一具有挑战性的模型进行数值研究成为现实可能。受这些进展推动，我们使用带神经量子态（NQS）的变分蒙特卡罗和投影纠缠对态（PEPS），研究三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中被认为可能存在的手性自旋液相。我们通过数值自旋泵浦模拟以及实时自旋和电荷运动，直接在实空间中观察到自旋—电荷分离。此外，在该模型中所猜想的任意子超导性的背景下，我们在小体系中发现正的双电子束缚能，但随着体系尺寸增大，它降低到我们的数值分辨率以下。我们的工作表明，NQS 和 PEPS 是强有力的工具，能够相互交叉验证，用于诊断强关联电子体系中的拓扑序和分数量子化激发。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments in moiré materials have enabled the realization of a variety of exotic quantum phases. In this context, the Hofstadter-Hubbard model has been proposed as a possible setting for hosting chiral spin liquid. Concurrently, significant progress has been recently made in the computational methods for two-dimensional many-body fermion systems, which makes numerically studying this challenging model a real possibility in genuine 2D geometry. Motivated by these advances, we investigate the putative chiral spin liquid phase in the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model using variational Monte Carlo with neural quantum states (NQS) and projected entangled pair states (PEPS). We observe spin-charge separation directly in real space through numerical spin-pumping simulation and real-time spin and charge motion. In addition, in the context of anyonic superconductivity conjectured in this model, we find a positive two-electron binding energy on small systems, but it decreases below our numerical resolution as the system size increases. Our work demonstrates NQS and PEPS as powerful tools, capable of cross-checking each other, for diagnosing topological order and fractionalized excitations in strongly correlated electronic systems.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.02965v1 公告类型：交叉。高频、高功率密度变换器中的磁性元件越来越多地由具有快速跃迁、小回线运行、直流偏置和温度变化的非正弦磁通密度波形驱动。在这些条件下，稳态磁芯损耗公式和单值材料曲线无法充分捕捉瞬态磁化响应。本文提出物理信息混合神经算子（PI-HNO），这是一种紧凑的材料专用神经模型，带有用于面向磁芯损耗的瞬态磁化预测的 B-H 能量一致性正则化。给定测得的 B(t)-H(t) 历史、预测区间内的输入 B(t) 序列以及工作条件信息，PI-HNO 预测 H(t) 序列及相应重构的 B-H 轨迹。该模型整合了一个用于边界状态表征和速率相关响应演化的局部递归分支，以及一个受 Preisach 启发、用于提取波形级磁滞上下文的全局分支。在 MagNetX 瞬态数据库上使用针对 14 种铁氧体材料的材料专用模型进行评估表明，PI-HNO 在序列精度与 B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性之间实现了紧凑折中；每个模型仅使用 4777 个可训练参数时，B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性误差的均值和第 95 百分位数分别为 1.92% 和 7.60%。消融研究进一步表明，局部、全局和能量感知正则化组件对瞬态磁化预测提供了不同的贡献。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02965v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic components in high-frequency, high-power-density converters are increasingly driven by non-sinusoidal flux-density waveforms with fast transitions, minor-loop operation, dc bias, and temperature variation. Under these conditions, steady-state core-loss formulas and single-valued material curves cannot fully capture transient magnetization responses. This work proposes the Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator (PI-HNO), a compact material-specific neural model with B-H energy-consistency regularization for core-loss-oriented transient magnetization prediction. Given the measured B(t)-H(t) history, the input B(t) series over the prediction interval and operating-condition information, PI-HNO predicts the H(t) series and the corresponding reconstructed B-H trajectory. The model integrates a local recurrent branch for boundary-state representation and rate-dependent response evolution with a Preisach-inspired global branch that extracts waveform-level hysteresis context. Evaluation on the MagNetX transient database using material-specific models for 14 ferrite materials demonstrates that PI-HNO achieves a compact trade-off between sequence accuracy and B(t)-H(t) energy consistency, with the mean and 95th percentile B(t)-H(t) energy consistency errors of 1.92% and 7.60%, respectively, using only 4777 trainable parameters per model. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the local, global, and energy-aware regularized components provide distinct contributions to transient magnetization prediction.

页内定位所在专题
中文摘要

从磁晶粒的磁滞回线外禀性质，即矫顽场、剩余磁化强度和最大磁能积，出发，根据其内禀微磁参数进行预测，是永磁体建模中的核心问题。已有解析模型能够提供有用估计，但通常忽略非均匀磁化过程，而直接微磁模拟的计算成本很高。在本工作中，我们在 12012 次理想化立方晶粒的微磁模拟数据上训练机器学习模型，涵盖饱和磁化强度、交换常数和单轴各向异性常数的宽广范围。在相同的保留测试数据上与解析模型进行基准比较时，机器学习模型对全部三种外禀性质的预测误差显著更低。符号回归恢复了矫顽场的 Kronmüller 形式，其中有效退磁因子依赖于材料，并找到了剩磁和最大磁能积的新闭式表达式。每条规律最多包含两个拟合常数，但其精度接近机器学习模型。我们还研究了从三种外禀性质恢复内禀参数的反问题。饱和磁化强度和各向异性常数能够被准确恢复，而交换常数不能，因为它对外禀性质的影响很弱。训练好的模型通过 mammos-ai Python 软件包发布，使得数千组候选参数可以在数秒内完成筛选，而直接微磁模拟则需要数小时或数天。

English Abstract

arXiv:2607.29249v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting the extrinsic properties from hysteresis loops of a magnetic grain, namely the coercive field, remanent magnetisation, and maximum energy product, from its intrinsic micromagnetic parameters is a central problem in permanent-magnet modelling. Established analytical models provide useful estimates but often neglect nonuniform magnetisation processes, whereas direct micromagnetic simulations are computationally expensive. In this work, we train machine-learning models on 12012 micromagnetic simulations of an idealised cubic grain, spanning broad ranges of the saturation magnetisation, exchange constant, and uniaxial anisotropy constant. Benchmarked against the analytical models on identical held-out data, the machine-learning models predict all three extrinsic properties with substantially lower errors. Symbolic regression recovers the Kronmüller form of the coercive field, with an effective demagnetising factor that depends on the material, and finds new closed-form expressions for the remanence and maximum energy product. Each law contains at most two fitted constants yet approaches the accuracy of the machine-learning models. We also investigate the inverse problem of recovering the intrinsic parameters from the three extrinsic properties. The saturation magnetisation and anisotropy constant are recovered accurately, whereas the exchange constant is not, because it influences the extrinsic properties only weakly. The trained models are released through the mammos-ai Python package, enabling thousands of candidate parameter sets to be screened in seconds rather than the hours or days required by direct micromagnetic simulation.

页内定位所在专题
中文摘要

《Nature Communications》，在线发表时间：2026年8月8日；doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76538-9。作者表明，范德华 Nb3Cl8 兼具可切换的电极化、异常的平带电子结构以及手性晶格振动，为研究量子材料和开发纳米器件提供了一个多功能平台。

English Abstract

Van der Waals layered Nb3X8(X=Cl, Br, I) are predicted to integrate multiple intriguing physical properties, notably multiferroicity and flat-bands that are highly promising for novel-principle memories and superconductors. However, direct experimental validations such as the proposed breathing ferroelectricity are lacking. Even the electronic band structure concerning flat-bands still remains inconsistent. Here, we systematically explore the structure and electrical/optical properties through a multifaceted study of Nb3Cl8. We demonstrate that, with an intralayer breathing Kagome lattice and an alternating van der Waals gap between adjacent layers, Nb3Cl8can exhibit breathing ferroelectricity originating from a breathing-in/out distortion of alternate triangles via a Kagome state. More strikingly, our optical characterizations disclose that Nb3Cl8shows the exciton-like absorption peaks involving flat-bands in thin states but semiconductor-like absorption edge in thick states possibly due to both interlayer interaction and thickness-induced stronger photon absorption, whose energies match our theoretical calculations, and possesses strong optical activity and multiple chiral phonons. Temperature dependencies of phonon modes and flat-bands consistently reveal several temperature-induced electronic-phase or magnetic-related transitions. The coexistence of these interrelated properties in Nb3Cl8not only offers a platform for exploring fundamental condensed matter physics but also holds great promise for developing multifunctional nanodevices.

中文摘要

铁磁 Kagome 体系中的多种化学取代可导致多样的磁相，并产生适合拓扑或量子材料性质的电子结构。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算研究了磁性 Kagome 化合物 ZrFe6Ge6、ZrFe6Ge4 和 ZrFe6Ge5 的电子结构和磁有序。对于 ZrFe6Ge6，得到的基态磁结构是 A 型反铁磁（AFM），与已有实验一致。我们预测 ZrFe6Ge4 和 ZrFe6Ge5 的磁基态为共线 A 型双层 AFM 结构，具有长周期有序，并包含铁磁和反铁磁层间取向的混合。这种长程磁结构的形成似乎是一种普遍特征，而并不依赖于特定取代。这些体系中的磁矩在很大程度上是局域的，并且只弱依赖于磁构型，其大小与已有实验估计值很好一致。因此，能够直接验证这些预测的中子散射实验具有特别重要的意义。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A wide variety of chemical substitutions in ferromagnetic Kagome systems can lead to diverse magnetic phases with electronic structures suitable for topological or quantum material properties. Here, we study the electronic structure and magnetic orderings using first-principles calculations for the magnetic Kagome compounds ZrFe6Ge6, ZrFe6Ge4, and ZrFe6Ge5. For ZrFe6Ge6, the obtained ground-state magnetic structure is A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM), in agreement with existing experiments. We predicted that the magnetic ground states of ZrFe6Ge4 and ZrFe6Ge5 are collinear A-type bilayer AFM structures with long-period ordering that involves a mix of FM and AFM interlayer orientations. The formation of such long-range magnetic structures appears to be a general feature and is not tied to specific substitutions. The magnetic moments in these systems are largely local and only weakly dependent on the magnetic configuration, with magnitudes in good agreement with available experimental estimates. Neutron scattering experiments, which could provide direct verification of these predictions, are therefore of particular importance.

中文摘要

稳定中心对称晶体中非共线磁性的机制仍不清楚，但很可能涉及由巡游电子介导的自旋—自旋相互作用，例如 RKKY 相互作用。有限 Q 磁有序于是可能伴随可用扫描隧道显微镜观测到的电子调制。在 GdRu₂Ge₂ 的五个连续磁相中，包括两个纳米尺度斯格明子晶体相，我们表明 Gd 4f 自旋中的多 Q 磁性伴随着对贡献巡游电子能带的 Ru 4d 轨道产生相应的多 Q 织构。通过对每种电子织构图案进行原子分辨成像，并采用一个基于底层自旋结构的简单数值建模方案，我们推断出它们的关键关系：最近邻 Gd 自旋之间的排列与 Gd 方形网络中两个键心子晶格上的 Ru 4d 轨道局域态密度密切相关。这些分析为非共线巡游磁体中电荷与自旋自由度在原子尺度上的交织提供了微观图像。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mechanisms stabilizing non-collinear magnetism in centrosymmetric crystals remain unclear, but likely involve spin-spin interactions mediated by itinerant electrons, such as the RKKY interaction. Finite-Q magnetic order may then be accompanied by electronic modulations that are observable using a scanning tunneling microscope. In five successive magnetic phases of GdRu₂Ge₂, including two nano-scale skyrmion crystal phases, we show that multi-Q magnetism among Gd 4f spins entails a corresponding multi-Q texture among the Ru 4d orbitals that contribute itinerant electron bands. With atomically-resolved images of each electronic texture's motif, and a simple numerical modeling scheme drawing on the underlying spin structures, we infer their key relationship: The alignment between nearest-neighbor Gd spins tightly correlates with the local density-of-states of the Ru 4d orbitals on the two bond-centered sublattices of the Gd square net. These analyses offer a microscopic view of the atomic-scale intertwining of charge and spin degrees-of-freedom in non-collinear itinerant magnets.

中文摘要

迄今为止，关于交替磁性的研究主要集中在磁性材料中自旋极化的体相电子态上。在这项工作中，我们通过引入表面交替磁性（SAM）的概念推进了该领域；在这种现象中，交替磁性自旋极化出现在共线反铁磁体（AFM）或交替磁体（AM）的表面。为奠定这一现象的理论基础，我们构建了一个全面的基于对称性的框架，系统地将这两类体系的体相自旋群与表面自旋群联系起来。通过对称性分析，我们识别出所有能够支持 SAM 的对称性破缺表面，其中 PT 对称 AFM 有 35 种，体相 AM 有 61 种不同情形。此外，我们表明，通过破缺分数平移对称性，203 个共线自旋空间群——包括 100 个不含 [C₂ Vert P] 操作以及 103 个含有该操作的空间群——允许在 tT 对称 AFM 的表面出现 SAM。所提出的框架通过紧束缚模型和第一性原理计算得到验证，并在 NaMnP、LiMnAs 和 CrSb 等代表性化合物中展示了实际材料实现。我们的结果确立了 SAM 作为一种稳健的、受对称性保护的磁态，将交替磁性现象扩展到材料表面，并为下一代自旋电子技术中先进的无外场自旋操控铺平道路。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Research on altermagnetism has thus far primarily focused on spin-polarized bulk electronic states in magnetic materials. In this work, we advance the field by introducing the concept of surface altermagnetism (SAM), wherein altermagnetic spin polarization emerges at the surfaces of collinear antiferromagnets (AFMs) or altermagnets (AMs). To lay the theoretical groundwork for this phenomenon, we construct a thorough symmetry-based framework that systematically connects bulk spin groups to surface spin groups for both types of systems. Through symmetry analysis, we identify all symmetry-breaking surfaces capable of supporting SAM, identifying 35 for PT-symmetric AFMs and 61 distinct cases for bulk AMs. Moreover, we show that 203 collinear spin space groups---including 100 without and 103 with the [C₂ Vert P] operation---permit the appearance of SAM on the surface of tT-symmetric AFMs via the breaking of fractional translational symmetries. The proposed framework is verified using tight-binding models and first-principles calculations, with practical material implementations shown in representative compounds like NaMnP, LiMnAs, and CrSb. Our results establish SAM as a robust, symmetry-protected magnetic state, extending altermagnetic phenomena to material surfaces and paving the way for advanced, field-free spin manipulation in next-generation spintronic technologies.

我们使用随机相近似，在一个适用于低电荷载流子浓度区间的简单杂质带模型中，计算了 (III,Mn)V 稀磁半导体的静态纵向磁化率和横向动态磁化率。结果表明，磁化率对 Mn 杂质的位置无序程度敏感依赖。我们得到的结果与先前关于这些材料的自旋波谱以及空间非均匀铁磁态的研究一致。

中文摘要

我们使用随机相近似，在一个适用于低电荷载流子浓度区间的简单杂质带模型中，计算了 (III,Mn)V 稀磁半导体的静态纵向磁化率和横向动态磁化率。结果表明，磁化率对 Mn 杂质的位置无序程度敏感依赖。我们得到的结果与先前关于这些材料的自旋波谱以及空间非均匀铁磁态的研究一致。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We calculate the static longitudinal and the transverse dynamic magnetic susceptibilities of (III,Mn)V diluted magnetic semiconductors, using the random phase approximation, for a simple impurity band model appropriate for the low charge carrier concentration regime. The magnetic susceptibilities are shown to depend sensitively on the amount of positional disorder of the Mn impurities. The results we obtain are consistent with previous studies of the spin wave spectrum and of the spatially inhomogeneous ferromagnetic state of these materials.

中文摘要

通过共振 X 射线衍射研究了 EuRhGe₃ 的磁结构；EuRhGe₃ 是一种空间群为 I4mm 的非中心对称体心四方磁体。在 TN=12 K 以下，EuRhGe₃ 发生螺旋磁有序，其非公度传播矢量为 q=(0, 0, 0.809)，其中磁矩位于 ab 平面内，并在相邻层之间以 145.8° 的恒定转角旋转。当在 2 K 下沿 a 轴施加磁场时，二次谐波 2q 峰发展起来，表明圆形螺旋逐渐畸变为螺旋磁孤子晶格态，并最终在 3.8 T 下经历锁定转变，进入 q=0.8 的公度结构。在随后 5 T 处的相边界以上，螺旋性消失，并实现自旋翻转 xyz 扇形（椭圆圆锥）态，其中磁矩主要沿 b 轴振荡，但伴随一个小的 c 轴分量。在更高磁场下，体系进入没有 c 轴分量的常规平面 xy 扇形相。EuRhGe₃ 提供了螺旋磁体的一个原型例子，它表现出完整的场诱导结构序列，从圆形螺旋演化到自旋翻转 xyz 扇形（椭圆圆锥），最终演化为平面 xy 扇形结构，这一序列此前已由理论预言。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetic structure of EuRhGe₃, a noncentrosymmetric body-centered tetragonal magnet with the space group I4mm, has been investigated by resonant X-ray diffraction. Below TN=12 K, EuRhGe₃ undergoes a helical magnetic ordering with an incommensurate propagation vector q=(0, 0, 0.809), in which the magnetic moments lie in the ab plane and rotate by a constant turn angle of 145.8ⁱ̧rc between adjacent layers. When a magnetic field is applied along the a axis at 2 K, a second-harmonic 2q peak develops, indicating that the circular helix is gradually distorted into a helimagnetic soliton-lattice state, which eventually undergoes a lock-in transition to the commensurate structure with q=0.8 at 3.8 T. Above the subsequent phase boundary at 5 T, the helicity is lost, and a spin-flop xyz-fan (elliptic conical) state is realized, in which the moments oscillate predominantly along the b axis but are accompanied by a small c-axis component. At higher fields, the system enters a conventional planar xy-fan phase without a c-axis component. EuRhGe₃ provides a prototypical example of a helimagnet that exhibits a full sequence of field-induced structures, evolving from a circular helix to a spin-flop xyz-fan (elliptic conical), and finally to a planar xy-fan structure, which has been theoretically predicted.

页内定位所在专题
中文摘要

我们对铁磁单层 Fe₃GeTe₂（FGT）和 Fe₃GaTe₂（FGaT）中的自旋—轨道力矩进行了系统的第一性原理研究。尽管两种材料具有相同的晶体结构（点群 D₃ₕ），并且能带主要由 Fe 3d 自旋极化态构成，但它们表现出显著不同的电流诱导力矩。我们通过利用线性响应理论和适应对称性的含自旋—轨道耦合 Wannier 函数计算 torkance——即单位外加电场产生的力矩——的完整角向依赖，揭示了这些差异。FGaT 可被视为 FGT 的空穴掺杂类似物，因为 Ga 比 Ge 少贡献一个价电子。尽管两者功函数仅相差约 28 meV，但 K 和 K' 附近的能带填充发生了显著变化：费米能级 εF 处的态密度降低了三倍，并且其自旋极化从 FGT 中的多数自旋反转为 FGaT 中的少数自旋。这些电子结构变化反映在按时间反演奇偶性、子晶格和动量分辨的力矩中。特别地，我们在 FGaT 中识别出显著的隐藏力矩，并将其四次谐波 Fermi 海分量的抑制与动量空间口袋的演化联系起来。最后，我们在基于对称性的唯象框架中讨论了这类自力矩的涌现；传统的电流诱导自旋积累图像无法捕捉这些力矩。我们的结果为二维铁磁体中的电流诱导力矩提供了微观洞见，并为层状磁性材料的缺陷工程和范德华工程提供了指导。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic first-principles study of the spin-orbit torques in the ferromagnetic monolayers Fe₃GeTe₂ (FGT) and Fe₃GaTe₂ (FGaT). Despite sharing the same crystal structure (point group D₃ₕ) and predominantly Fe~3d spin-polarized bands, the two materials exhibit markedly different current-induced torques. We reveal these differences by computing the full angular dependence of the torkance---the torque per unit applied electric field---using linear-response theory with symmetry-adapted spin--orbit-coupled Wannier functions. FGaT may be viewed as a hole-doped analogue of FGT, since Ga contributes one valence electron fewer than Ge. Although the work functions differ by only about 28~meV, the band filling near K and K' changes substantially: the density of states at ǎrepsilon_F is reduced by a factor of three and its spin polarization reverses from majority in FGT to minority in FGaT. These electronic changes are reflected in the torques resolved by time-reversal parity, sublattice, and momentum. In particular, we identify pronounced hidden torques in FGaT and relate the suppression of its fourth-harmonic Fermi-sea component to the evolution of momentum-space pockets. Finally, we discuss the emergence of such self-torques, which are not captured by the conventional picture of current-induced spin accumulation, within a symmetry-based phenomenological framework. Our results provide microscopic insight into current-induced torques in two-dimensional ferromagnets and offer guidance for defect and van der Waals engineering of layered magnetic materials.

Correlated topological-polarization surface states in the narrow-gap insulator FeSb2

强电子关联和能带拓扑各自都能产生丰富的量子相，但二者对元素组成的相互冲突要求在很大程度上使它们彼此分离。拓扑极化提供了一条将二者统一起来的路径，它能够在无需自旋–轨道耦合的情况下由成键电荷产生极性表面态，从而将能带拓扑扩展到关联的3d过渡金属化合物。在这里，我们证明窄带隙绝缘体FeSb2的外延薄膜承载着源于拓扑极化的金属性极性表面态，并且这些表面态受体相强关联支配。非互易表面输运只在由关联驱动的体相Fe 3d轨道占据重构的起始温度以下出现，这为关联拓扑体系中的体–边对应关系提供了直接证据。此外，静电栅控驱动这一关联表面跨越量子相变，进入铁磁态或可能的交变磁态。我们的结果确立了拓扑极化作为在广泛材料中设计关联拓扑相的原则。

arXiv:2608.05887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong electron correlations and band topology each generate rich quantum phases, but conflicting elemental requirements have largely kept them apart. Topological polarization offers a route to unite them, producing polar surface states from bonding charge without spin-orbit coupling and thereby extending band topology to correlated 3d transition-metal compounds. Here we demonstrate that epitaxial thin films of the narrow-gap insulator FeSb2 host metallic polar surface states of topological-polarization origin, governed by the strong correlations of the bulk. Nonreciprocal surface transport emerges only below the onset temperature of a correlation-driven reconstruction of the bulk Fe 3d orbital occupation, providing direct evidence of bulk-edge correspondence in a correlated topological system. Moreover, electrostatic gating drives this correlated surface across a quantum phase transition into a ferromagnetic or possibly altermagnetic state. Our results establish topological polarization as a design principle for correlated topological phases in a broad range of materials.

中文摘要

晶体的对称性常常限制其物理性质。特别是，它们决定了描述原子间交换相互作用的张量可能具有的形式，而这些交换相互作用支配着广泛的磁性现象。通过考虑对称性约束，可以大大简化计算量很大的第一性原理交换张量计算。在这里，我们介绍Jsymm，这是一个Python软件包，能够直接从晶体学数据推导出交换张量最一般的、与对称性相容的形式。对于由磁性离子形成的任意键，Jsymm会以符号形式给出Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和各向异性Heisenberg交换相互作用的张量，以及所有其他与之由对称性相关的键的张量。这减少了独立模型参数的数量，显著降低了从头算计算成本，并防止因违反对称性而产生非物理结果。该软件包接受标准CIF文件，除交互式文本模式和Python库外，还提供网页界面。我们在La₂CuO₄和α-Fe₂O₃上展示了其用途，重现了已知的对称性约束，并揭示了不同键的交换张量分量之间的额外关系。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetries of a crystal often restrict its physical properties. In particular, they determine possible forms of the tensors that describe interatomic exchange interaction, which governs a wide range of magnetic phenomena. Computationally demanding first-principles calculations of the exchange tensors can be greatly simplified by taking the symmetry constraints into account. Here, we present Jsymm, a Python package that derives the most general symmetry-compatible form of the exchange tensors directly from the crystallographic data. For any bond formed by magnetic ions, Jsymm produces the tensors of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya and anisotropic Heisenberg exchange interaction in symbolic form, as well as the tensors for all other bonds related to it by symmetry. This reduces the number of independent model parameters, dramatically lowering the computational cost of the ab initio calculations and preventing unphysical results arising from symmetry violations. The package accepts standard CIF files and provides a web interface in addition to an interactive text mode and a Python library. We demonstrate its utility on La₂CuO₄ and α-Fe₂O₃, reproducing known symmetry constraints and revealing additional relations between components of the exchange tensors of different bonds.

我们使用超越常规晶胞描述的层级平均场理论，研究了方形kagome晶格上的硬核玻色子模型。我们表明，基于其最小晶胞的方形kagome晶格常规描述并不能完全捕捉该晶格所支持的不可压缩态层级，而只能捕捉密度为5/6和2/3的两个基于紧致局域态的相。在我们的方法中，我们重现了这些此前已确立的相，并发现了通过扩大变分团簇而得以出现的额外不可压缩态。其中，ρ=3/4相被发现尤其稳健；通过Matsubara-Matsuda映射，它对应于自旋1/2 XXZ模型中的半磁化平台。我们进一步将该方法应用于两种具有实验相关性的方形kagome化合物，所用交换参数来自第一性原理计算。计算得到的磁化过程与已有实验结果符合良好，并预测了这些材料中的额外平台结构。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05927v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a hard-core boson model on the square-kagome lattice using hierarchical mean-field theory beyond the conventional unit-cell description. We show that the conventional description of the square-kagome lattice based on its smallest unit cell does not fully capture the hierarchy of incompressible states supported by the lattice, but only captures the two compact-localized-state-based phases at densities 5/6 and 2/3. Within our approach, we reproduce these previously established phases and uncover additional incompressible states enabled by enlarging the variational cluster. Among these, the h̊o=3/4 phase is found to be particularly robust, which, through the Matsubara-Matsuda mapping, corresponds to a half-magnetization plateau in the spin-1/2 XXZ model. We further apply our approach to two experimentally relevant square-kagome compounds using exchange parameters obtained from first-principles calculations. The calculated magnetization processes are in good agreement with available experimental results and predict additional plateau structures in these materials.

中文摘要

我们研究了由与序参量场耦合的时间依赖周期性均匀外源所产生的临界动力学，该外源驱动一个经典铁磁系统跨越连续相变。为此，我们考虑了范例性的二维（2D）Ising模型，该模型处于周期磁场 h(t)=-A cos(2π t/P) 中，并在临界温度下按照纯弛豫动力学演化。我们表明，在热力学极限中，周期性驱动会产生一种特殊的动态标度行为，这源于时间t以及h(t)的振幅A和周期P之间的非平凡相互作用。相关的标度变量为τ=t/P和σ=A P^κ，其中κ=yₕ/z，yₕ=(d+2-η)/2是磁场的临界维数，z是临界弛豫动力学的动态指数（对于二维Ising模型，κ约为0.865）。磁化强度和键能密度的动态标度行为表现为围绕一条平滑曲线的振荡行为，并且该曲线趋近于大τ下的定常行为。我们还简要讨论了在零磁场下由周期性随时间变化的温度驱动跨越临界点的Ising系统的动态行为。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.05936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the critical dynamics arising from a time-dependent periodic homogenous source coupled to the order-parameter field, which drives a classical ferromagnetic system across a continuous transition. For this purpose, we consider the paradigmatic two-dimensional (2D) Ising model in the presence of a periodic magnetic field h(t)=-A, o̧s (2π t/P), evolving under a purely relaxational dynamics at the critical temperature. We show that the periodic driving gives rise to a peculiar dynamic scaling behavior in the thermodynamic limit, arising from a nontrivial interplay among the time t, the amplitude A and period P of h(t). The relevant scaling variables are τ=t/P and σ=A P^κ, with κ = yₕ/z, where yₕ₌₍d+2-η)/2 is the critical dimension of the magnetic field, and z is dynamic exponent for the critical relaxational dynamics (κapprox 0.865 for the 2D Ising model). The dynamic scaling behaviors of the magnetization and bond-energy density show an oscillatory behavior around a smooth curve which approaches a large-τ stationary behavior. We also briefly discuss the dynamic behavior of an Ising system driven across the critical point by a periodic time-varying temperature at zero magnetic field.

中文摘要

电霍尔效应（EHE）是二维（2D）磁性系统中的一种独特现象，指由面外电场 Ez 产生霍尔电流。本文中，我们证明，对于具有双重简并节点的二维磁性 Weyl 半金属，EHE 呈现出多种非常规标度律。在零温下，EHE 表现出拓扑性的 E_F⁻¹ 费米能标度。值得注意的是，该标度的前因子由该点的整体拓扑荷决定，而不依赖于系统的任何局域参数，从而在费米能接近 Weyl 点时，在任何类型的 Weyl 点中都导致普适且显著增强的霍尔响应。这种显著响应使弱电场能够被直接转换为可测量的霍尔信号。令人惊讶的是，这种增强的霍尔响应不会被温度削弱，而是在有限温度下演化为一种带有非常规对数修正的标度，在弱 Ez 下有 σₓy ∝ Ez ln(1/|Ez|)，仍然产生发散的电场磁化率。因此，我们的工作不仅揭示了由磁性与拓扑相互作用产生的引人关注的标度律，而且提出了一种新的、由标度增强且温度稳健的机制，该机制可能通过实际可行的全电学路线实现弱电场传感。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.06217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric Hall Effect (EHE), a unique phenomenon in two-dimensional (2D) magnetic systems, refers to the generation of Hall current by an out-of-plane electric field Ez. Here, we demonstrate that for 2D magnetic Weyl semimetals that host doubly degenerate nodal points, the EHE features multiple unconventional scaling laws. At zero temperature, the EHE exhibits a topological E_F⁻¹ Fermi-energy scaling. Remarkably, the prefactor of the scaling is determined by the global topological charge of the point without any dependence on the local parameters of the system, leading to a universal and significant enhancement of Hall response in any species of Weyl points as the Fermi energy approaches the Weyl point. This significant response enables a weak electric field to be directly converted into a measurable Hall signal. Surprisingly, this enhanced Hall response is not diminished by temperature, but evolves into an unconventional logarithmically corrected scaling at finite temperature σₓyproptoEzłn(1/|Ez|) for weak Ez, still yielding a divergent electric-field susceptibility. Thus, our work not only unveils intriguing scaling laws resulting from the interaction between magnetism and topology, but also suggests a novel scaling-enhanced and temperature-robust mechanism that may enable weak electric-field sensing through a practical and all-electric route.

在合成过程中控制纳米颗粒尺寸仍然是纳米科学中的核心挑战，尤其是在外部磁场被用作连续控制参数的体系中。现有关于磁场辅助成核的描述通常具有材料特异性，或依赖计算量很大的原子级方法。本文中，我们通过引入原子组装的球堆积表示，将经典成核理论重新表述为一种几何闭合的热力学框架。这一构造在外加磁场下建立了离散原子结构与连续自由能贡献之间的直接联系，从而得到临界核尺寸的场驱动演化方程。所得理论在单一形式体系内为超顺磁、顺磁和抗磁系统中的纳米颗粒成核提供了统一描述。它定量再现了此前关于磁铁矿和镍纳米颗粒尚未解决的实验观测，即随着磁场增强，平均粒径系统性减小且尺寸分布变窄。在抗磁极限下，该框架恢复了我们早先针对银纳米颗粒提出的基于磁化率的解析描述，其中依赖磁场的临界半径由诱导磁化对成核自由能的贡献所控制。除了模拟随磁场增强而出现的平均粒径减小之外，该框架还揭示，尺寸分布变窄自然源于经磁场修正的自由能景观的曲率。这些结果确立了磁场辅助成核是一种受几何约束的热力学过程，为跨不同磁性材料类别控制纳米颗粒尺寸提供了一条计算高效的途径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.06220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling nanoparticle size during synthesis remains a central challenge in nanoscience, particularly in systems where external magnetic fields are used as continuous control parameters. Existing descriptions of magnetic-field-assisted nucleation are typically material-specific or rely on computationally intensive atomistic methods. Here, we reformulate classical nucleation theory as a geometrically closed thermodynamic framework by introducing a sphere-packing representation of atomic assembly. This construction establishes a direct link between discrete atomic structure and continuum free-energy contributions under applied magnetic fields, yielding a field-driven evolution equation for the critical nucleus size. The resulting theory provides a unified description of nanoparticle nucleation across superparamagnetic, paramagnetic, and diamagnetic systems within a single formalism. It quantitatively reproduces previously unresolved experimental observations for magnetite and nickel nanoparticles, namely the systematic reduction of mean particle size and narrowing of size distributions with increasing magnetic field. In the diamagnetic limit, the framework recovers our earlier analytical susceptibility-based description of silver nanoparticles, in which the field-dependent critical radius is governed by the induced-magnetization contribution to the nucleation free energy. Beyond modeling the reduction of mean particle size with increasing magnetic field, the framework reveals that the narrowing of size distributions emerges naturally from the curvature of the field-modified free-energy landscape. These results establish magnetic-field-assisted nucleation as a geometrically constrained thermodynamic process, providing a computationally efficient route for controlling nanoparticle size across distinct magnetic material classes.

中文摘要

我们提出，补偿共线磁性系统中的子晶格电流是实现奇宇称交替磁性（ALM）的一条可行途径，在这种磁性中，能带中的非相对论共线自旋劈裂作为动量的奇函数出现。与此前分类的 ALM 不同，子晶格电流在非磁性晶体结构中破坏时间反演对称性，并允许这种奇宇称自旋劈裂。一个代表性例子是半填充的 Haldane-Hubbard 模型。尽管其补偿共线磁性基态此前被认为是反铁磁性，我们表明它实际上是一种奇宇称 ALM。有趣的是，其拓扑版本可作为 ALM 陈绝缘体的一个例子。我们进一步将 Haldane-Hubbard 模型推广到常见的二维和三维二分晶格。由于子晶格电流允许自旋劈裂，半填充下的补偿共线磁性基态通常是奇宇称 ALM。

English Abstract

arXiv:2503.09602v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose the sublattice currents in a compensated collinear magnetic system as a feasible route to odd-parity altermagnetism (ALM), where nonrelativistic collinear spin splitting occurs in the bands as an odd function of momentum. In contrast to previously classified ALMs, the sublattice currents break the time-reversal symmetry in the nonmagnetic crystal structure and allow for such odd-parity spin splitting. A representative example is the Haldane-Hubbard model at half filling. Although the compensated collinear magnetic ground state was previously recognized as antiferromagnetism, we show that it is actually an odd-parity ALM. Interestingly, its topological version serves as an example of an ALM Chern insulator. We further generalize the Haldane-Hubbard model to common two- and three-dimensional bipartite lattices. With spin splitting allowed by sublattice currents, the compensated collinear magnetic ground states at half filling are generally odd-parity ALM.

我们报告了对绝缘稀土三角晶格磁体 CsErSe₂ 低温磁性质的全面研究。我们发现晶体电场（CEF）基态中存在场诱导能级交叉，该交叉导致一级相变并产生独特的磁性质。通过精确确定单离子哈密顿量来识别这一交叉，而场依赖光学光谱直接追踪克拉默斯双重态的塞曼劈裂，从而显著提高了该哈密顿量的可靠性。我们还观察到 CsErSe₂ 在 T_N 约为 110 mK 以下出现自发反铁磁有序，并利用弹性中子散射解析了相应的磁结构。我们讨论了 CsErSe₂ 丰富的磁行为如何源于非平凡的场依赖单离子物理与自发有序之间的相互作用，并强调这些结果对于理解广泛绝缘稀土磁体中的磁现象所具有的意义。

English Abstract

arXiv:2510.21616v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a comprehensive study of the low-temperature magnetic properties of the insulating rare-earth triangular magnet CsErSe₂. We uncover a field-induced level crossing at the crystal electric field (CEF) ground state, which gives rise to a first order phase transition as well as to distinctive magnetic properties. This crossing is identified by the accurate determination of the single-ion Hamiltonian, the reliability of which is substantially enhanced by field-dependent optical spectroscopy that directly tracks the Zeeman splittings of Kramers doublets. We also observe spontaneous antiferromagnetic ordering in CsErSe₂ below T_N approx 110 mK, and resolve the corresponding magnetic structure using elastic neutron scattering. We discuss how the rich magnetic behavior of CsErSe₂ arises from the interplay of non-trivial field-dependent single-ion physics and spontaneous ordering, and highlight the implications of these results for understanding magnetic phenomena across a wide range of insulating rare-earth magnets.

中文摘要

我们研究一种 Kagome 交错磁性金属中的拓扑电子响应，该金属具有补偿的共面 120° 磁织构。利用包含近邻跃迁、非共线交换耦合、本征自旋—轨道耦合以及时间反演奇性的环电流序的最小紧束缚模型，我们分离出支配电子响应的磁性、轨道和相对论机制。交换场产生显著的动量依赖自旋劈裂和自旋极化费米面，而不产生净磁化。然而，在没有环电流序的情况下，隐藏的反幺正对称性 TC₂z 强制贝里曲率和本征反常霍尔电导为零，即使存在有限自旋—轨道耦合也是如此。定向虚键序打破这种保护，并且即使在非相对论极限下也会激活有限贝里曲率和一个显著且强烈依赖填充的霍尔响应。随后，自旋—轨道耦合重构避免交叉并重新分布贝里曲率，根据填充情况增强或抑制霍尔响应。对于足够强的环电流序和自旋—轨道耦合，在 nₑ₌₃ 处会打开全局能隙，霍尔电导接近 2e²/h，与大小为二的占据带陈数相一致。参数空间和填充依赖计算进一步表明，霍尔活性区域在交换耦合、自旋—轨道耦合和化学势的宽广范围内延伸，并且对保持对称性的长程跃迁具有稳健性。这些结果表明，轨道电流序是一条独立途径，可在没有净磁化、非共面自旋序或标量自旋手性的情况下，将霍尔静默的 Kagome 交错磁体转化为反常霍尔金属或有能隙拓扑相。

English Abstract

arXiv:2606.04984v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate topological electronic responses in a kagome altermagnetic metal hosting a compensated coplanar 120ⁱ̧rc magnetic texture. Using a minimal tight-binding model containing nearest-neighbor hopping, noncollinear exchange coupling, intrinsic spin--orbit coupling, and a time-reversal-odd loop-current order, we disentangle the magnetic, orbital, and relativistic mechanisms governing the electronic response. The exchange field produces pronounced momentum-dependent spin splitting and spin-polarized Fermi surfaces without generating a net magnetization. Nevertheless, in the absence of loop-current order, a hidden antiunitary symmetry TC₂z enforces vanishing Berry curvature and intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity, even for finite spin--orbit coupling. A directed imaginary bond order breaks this protection and activates finite Berry curvature and a sizable, strongly filling-dependent Hall response already in the nonrelativistic limit. Spin--orbit coupling subsequently reconstructs the avoided crossings and redistributes the Berry curvature, enhancing or suppressing the Hall response depending on filling. For sufficiently strong loop-current order and spin--orbit coupling, a global gap opens at nₑ₌₃, and the Hall conductivity approaches 2e²/h, consistent with an occupied-band Chern number of magnitude two. Parameter-space and filling-dependent calculations further demonstrate that the Hall-active regime extends over broad ranges of exchange coupling, spin--orbit coupling, and chemical potential and remains robust against symmetry-preserving longer-range hopping. These results identify orbital-current order as an independent route for converting a Hall-silent kagome altermagnet into an anomalous Hall metal or a gapped topological phase without net magnetization, noncoplanar spin order, or scalar spin chirality.

中文摘要

利用 Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire 方法，我们表明电极化矢量与反铁畸变长程序参量赝矢量之间的线性梯度型耦合可以出现在所有反铁畸变铁弹体中，因为它在对称性上是允许的；这种耦合具有 Lifshitz 不变量的形式，并被称为“双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合”。利用四子晶格模型，我们揭示双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合能够在没有任何铁电或反铁电有序的反铁畸变铁弹体的孪晶壁和反相边界处诱导对子晶格敏感的极化。由于诱导极化垂直于反铁畸变长程序参量，并且在具有棋盘型反铁畸变长程序参量方向的相邻子晶格中反向排列，这种极化结构可能对应于交电型四极电序。然而，在大多数纳米结构反铁畸变铁电体和反铁电体中，由于压电耦合和/或无处不在的线性挠曲电耦合占主导，双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合的物理表现不可见。双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合能够在没有任何铁电或反铁电长程序的铁弹体中，在反铁畸变畴边界附近诱导交电型极化。

English Abstract

arXiv:2606.29456v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using the Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire approach we show that the linear gradient-type coupling between the electric polarization vector and antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter pseudovector, that has the form of Lifshitz invariant and named "bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling", can emerge in all antiferrodistortive ferroelastics, since it is symmetry-allowed. Using the four sublattices model we reveal that the bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling can induce the sublattice-sensitive polarization at the twin walls and antiphase boundaries in antiferrodistortive ferroelastics without any ferroelectric or antiferroelectric ordering. Since the induced polarization is perpendicular to the antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter and counter-directed in neighboring sublattices with checkerboard-type direction of antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter, such structure of polarization may correspond to the alterelectric-type quadrupolar electric order. However, physical manifestations of the bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling are invisible in most nanostructured antiferrodistortive ferroelectrics and antiferroelectrics due to the domination of piezoelectric and/or omnipresent linear flexoelectric couplings. The bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling can induce alterelectric-type polarization near antiferrodistortive domain boundaries in ferroelastics without any ferroelectric or antiferroelectric long-range ordering.

低维性增强量子涨落，触发新型量子物质态的出现。在真实材料中，低维性通常源自空间上强各向异性的耦合。在这里，我们展示一种不同的机制：在由耦合的交替铁磁（FM）和反铁磁（AFM）自旋 1/2 链组成的二维体系中，外加磁场可能驱动维度降低。在磁场作用下，FM 链极化并变得刚硬，从而抑制横向 AFM 涨落从一条链向另一条链传播，并在低能下有效诱导一维行为。对于描述 botallackite Cu₂(OH)₃Br 的模型，量子 Monte Carlo 动力学显示，在超过一个临界磁场之后，低能谱约化为一维 AFM Heisenberg 自旋 1/2 链的谱，并具有依赖磁场的非公度双自旋子涨落，为非弹性中子散射提供了清晰特征。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.04096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low dimensionality enhances quantum fluctuations, triggering novel states of quantum matter to emerge. In real materials, low dimensionality usually arises from spatially strongly anisotropic couplings. Here, we demonstrate a different mechanism: in two-dimensional systems with coupled alternating ferromagnetic (FM) and antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin-1/2 chains, an applied magnetic field may drive a dimensional reduction. Under magnetic field, the FM chains polarize and stiffen, suppressing the propagation of transverse AFM fluctuations from one chain to another, and effectively induce one-dimensional behavior at low energies. For a model describing botallackite, Cu₂₍OH)₃Br, quantum Monte Carlo dynamics show that beyond a critical magnetic field, the low-energy spectrum reduces to that of a one-dimensional AFM Heisenberg spin-1/2 chain with field-dependent incommensurate two-spinon fluctuations, providing clear signatures for inelastic neutron scattering.

静水压力提供了一种保持对称性的途径，可用于调控关联绝缘交变磁体La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂中的电子和磁振子输运。通过结合第一性原理计算与自旋哈密顿量建模，我们表明，从0到40 GPa的压缩会显著增强相互竞争的第二近邻交换相互作用之间的不等价性，使|J₂ₐ-J₂b|从1.97 meV增加到9.38 meV，同时保持补偿反铁磁基态。由此产生的交换各向异性放大了两个手征磁振子分支之间的动量依赖分裂，使100 K下纵向磁振子驱动的自旋塞贝克响应近乎增强四倍，从3.68×10⁻¹ meV/K增加到1.36 meV/K。相比之下，静水压力保持了支配反常霍尔效应的磁对称性选择定则，同时重新分布电子贝里曲率，从而在反常霍尔电导中产生显著的能量依赖符号反转。这些结果确定交换各向异性是压力增强磁振子响应背后的微观机制，并确立静水压力是同时控制绝缘交变磁体中电子和磁振子输运的有效手段。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.04184v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrostatic pressure provides a symmetry-preserving route to engineer electronic and magnonic transport in the correlated insulating altermagnet La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂. Using first-principles calculations combined with spin-Hamiltonian modeling, we show that compression from 0 to 40 GPa markedly enhances the inequivalence between the competing second-neighbor exchange interactions, increasing |J₂ₐ-J₂b| from 1.97 to 9.38 meV while preserving the compensated antiferromagnetic ground state. The resulting exchange anisotropy amplifies the momentum-dependent splitting between the two chiral magnon branches, yielding a nearly fourfold enhancement of the longitudinal magnon-driven spin Seebeck response at 100 K, from 3.68×10⁻¹ to 1.36 meV/K. In contrast, hydrostatic pressure preserves the magnetic-symmetry selection rules governing the anomalous Hall effect while redistributing the electronic Berry curvature, producing pronounced energy-dependent sign reversals in the anomalous Hall conductivity. These results identify exchange anisotropy as the microscopic mechanism underlying the pressure-enhanced magnon response and establish hydrostatic pressure as an effective means of simultaneously controlling electronic and magnonic transport in insulating altermagnets.

中文摘要

我们从二维单分量φ⁴晶格场论的连通二粒子关联函数的蒙特卡罗测量中重构2PI顶角Γ(k,p;q)，并跟踪其跨越Ising转变的变化。通过在点群C₄ᵥ的不可约表示中分辨该顶角，我们发现不稳定性由零转移处的A₁（铁磁）通道驱动，其对称化Bethe--Salpeter核的主本征值接近1。在所有系统尺寸中，显著的B₁（向列）和B₂（对角向列）贡献都与A₁协同作用，突出表明软扇区是多维的。在实空间中，顶角在远离临界性时为短程，而在临界点发展出幂律尾。在有序相中，q=0本征值塌缩，因为铁磁权重已经凝聚到（一粒子可约的）序参量中（或对有限系统而言凝聚到集体坐标中），尽管有限动量涨落仍然存在。通过剥离交叉通道梯子图，我们获得了完全不可约顶角，它在非常好的近似下是一个局域接触项。将该接触项代入parquet方程和Schwinger--Dyson方程后，它以优于千分之一的精度再现了蒙特卡罗自能。这为动力学局域顶角近似（DΓA）提供了一个第一性原理基准。此外，我们证明，在临界区域中，parquet方程的物理解表现为排斥不动点，其初始由单一序参量模驱动。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.04497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We reconstruct the 2PI vertex Γ(k,p;q) from Monte Carlo measurements of the connected two-particle correlator for the two-dimensional single-component φ⁴ lattice field theory and follow it across the Ising transition. Resolving the vertex in the irreducible representations of the point group C₄ᵥ, we find that the instability is driven by the A₁ (ferromagnetic) channel at zero transfer, whose leading eigenvalue of the symmetrized Bethe--Salpeter kernel approaches unity. Substantial B₁ (nematic) and B₂ (diagonal nematic) contributions cooperate with A₁ across all system sizes, highlighting that the soft sector is multidimensional. In real space, the vertex is short-ranged away from criticality while it develops a power-law tail at the critical point. In the ordered phase, the q=0 eigenvalue collapses because the ferromagnetic weight has condensed into the (one-particle-reducible) order parameter (or collective coordinate for a finite system), although finite-momentum fluctuations persist. By stripping the crossed-channel ladders, we obtain the fully irreducible vertex, which is a local contact -- to a very good approximation. Inserted into the parquet and Schwinger--Dyson equations, this contact reproduces the Monte Carlo self-energy with an accuracy better than one-tenth of a percent. This provides a first-principles benchmark of the dynamical local-vertex approximation (DΓA). Additionally, we demonstrate that in the critical region, the physical solution of the parquet equations behaves as a repulsive fixed point, driven initially by a single order-parameter mode.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.04888v1 发布类型：新论文 摘要：全二维磁隧道结有望实现原子级锐利的界面，然而界面诱导态在其自旋输运中的作用尚未得到充分理解。本文从理论上研究了结构为 Cr₂C/MY₂/Cr₂C（M = Mo、W；Y = S、Se）的范德华磁隧道结中的自旋依赖输运，势垒厚度分别为 3、5、7 和 9 层。kₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ 分辨电导的总体特征，即 Γ 点附近的抑制以及六个偏离 Γ 点热点处的增强，与势垒中倏逝态的衰减相一致。然而，三层 WS₂、MoSe₂ 和 WSe₂ 势垒在热点内的 kₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ 点处表现出量级为 e²/h 的电导。我们将这些接近单位透射的通道归因于两个电极—势垒界面处界面态之间的共振耦合，其证据是这些界面态在势垒中心具有微弱但有限的残余权重。对于更厚的势垒，这种耦合减弱，从而抑制残余权重，进而降低 MoS₂ 结的隧道磁阻（TMR）比，同时增强其他结的隧道磁阻比。为了利用界面态实现自旋选择性隧穿，我们进一步考察了施加于三层结的双轴拉伸应变。在 4% 应变下，MoS₂ 的 TMR 比从 176% 增至 540%，WS₂ 的 TMR 比从 98% 增至 496%，而 MoSe₂ 和 WSe₂ 的增强相对较弱。我们的结果表明，通过应变和势垒厚度进行界面态工程，是增强全二维磁隧道结中 TMR 效应的有效途径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.04888v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: All-two-dimensional magnetic tunnel junctions promise atomically sharp interfaces, yet the role of interface-induced states in their spin transport is not fully understood. Here, we theoretically investigate spin-dependent transport in van der Waals magnetic tunnel junctions of the structure Cr₂C/MY₂/Cr₂C (M = Mo, W; Y = S, Se) with barrier thicknesses of 3, 5, 7, and 9 layers. The broad features of the kₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ-resolved conductances, namely suppression near the Γ point and enhancement at six off-Γ hot spots, are consistent with the decay of evanescent states in the barrier. However, trilayer WS₂, MoSe₂, and WSe₂ barriers exhibit conductances of the order of e²/h at kₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ points within the hot spots. We attribute these near-unity transmission channels to resonant coupling between the interfacial states at the two electrode--barrier interfaces, as evidenced by their weak but finite residual weight at the barrier center. For thicker barriers, this coupling weakens, which suppresses the residual weight, thereby reducing the tunnel magnetoresistance (TMR) ratio of the MoS₂ junction while enhancing those of the other junctions. To exploit the interfacial states for spin-selective tunneling, we further examine biaxial tensile strain applied to the trilayer junctions. At 4% strain, the TMR ratio increases from 176% to 540% for MoS₂ and from 98% to 496% for WS₂, whereas MoSe₂ and WSe₂ exhibit comparatively weaker enhancement. Our results establish interfacial-state engineering via strain and barrier thickness as effective routes for enhancing the TMR effect in all-two-dimensional magnetic tunnel junctions.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.04946v1 公告类型：新摘要：我们对高度各向异性的非化学计量 CeCuBi2 单晶的结构、角度依赖磁性及磁输运性质进行了详细研究。结果表明，CeCuBi2 是一种各向异性的 Kondo 反铁磁体，表现出复杂的场致磁性行为和异常的磁输运性质。磁化率和比热测量表明，该材料在 TN = 14 K 以下发生反铁磁（AFM）有序，且具有强各向异性和弱重费米子行为。电输运测量显示出高度各向异性的电阻率，以及在约 47 K 处出现的宽峰，这表明存在由 Kondo 主导的重费米子行为。磁化测量揭示了多个场致元磁相，而交流磁化率测量则表明中间场致磁态中存在缓慢自旋动力学和类自旋玻璃行为。此外，我们观察到显著且强各向异性的磁输运响应，包括在 300 K 和 9 T 下约 22% 的室温磁阻，以及蝶形各向异性磁电阻，其 AMR 值最高约达 10.9%。这些结果突出了 Kondo 关联、磁各向异性与场可调自旋构型之间的强烈相互作用，使 CeCuBi2 成为探索关联且各向异性量子现象的潜在平台。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.04946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a detailed study on the structural, angle-dependent magnetic and magnetotransport properties of highly anisotropic off-stoichiometric CeCuBi2 single crystals. Our results reveal CeCuBi2 as an anisotropic Kondo antiferromagnet exhibiting complex field-induced magnetic behavior and unusual magnetotransport properties. Magnetic susceptibility and specific heat measurements reveal antiferromagnetic (AFM) ordering below TN = 14 K with strong anisotropy and weak heavy-fermion behavior. Electrical transport measurements show highly anisotropic resistivity and a broad hump around 47 K, indicative of Kondo-driven heavy-fermion behavior. Magnetization measurements reveal multiple field-induced metamagnetic phases, while AC susceptibility measurements indicate slow spin dynamics and spin-glass-like behavior in intermediate field-induced magnetic states. Furthermore, we observe large and strongly anisotropic magneto transport responses, including room-temperature magnetoresistance of approximately 22% at 300 K and 9 T and butterfly-like anisotropic magnetoresistance with AMR values reaching approximately 10.9%. These results highlight a strong interplay among Kondo correlations, magnetic anisotropy, and field-tunable spin configurations, making CeCuBi2 a possible platform for exploring correlated and anisotropic quantum phenomena.

中文摘要

奇宇称磁体最近被提出可通过Floquet工程在共线反铁磁体（AFMs）中涌现，其谷依赖的自旋劈裂构成奇宇称自旋极化的基础。这个设想带来两个关键挑战：探测自旋劈裂以验证这些磁体的生成机制，以及识别这种极化以确认奇宇称本性。这里，我们表明Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida（RKKY）相互作用为这两项任务提供了一个统一的磁学探针。以共线f波磁体作为代表性例子，我们发现RKKY相互作用会产生自旋劈裂的不同磁信号——包括Heisenberg/Ising项中的磁性反转以及Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）项中的符号交替——这使得能够将共线f波磁体与其他相关AFMs清楚地区分开来。此外，DM项呈现f波形状并具有奇宇称对称性，满足JαβDM(R) = -JαβDM(C₂qR)（q=3），这直接反映了动量空间中的奇宇称自旋极化S_z(k) = -S_z(C₂qk)。这种行为在p波磁体（q=1）中同样存在，表明我们方法的普适性。我们的工作将RKKY相互作用确立为一种多功能探针，可用于检测共线奇宇称磁体的能带特征，其预测可通过现有实验技术实现，例如自旋极化扫描隧道谱学。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.04969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Odd-parity magnets were recently proposed to emerge in collinear antiferromagnets (AFMs) via Floquet engineering, with valley-dependent spin splitting underlying the odd-parity spin polarization. This proposal brings about two key challenges: detecting the spin splitting to verify the generation mechanism of these magnets, and identifying such polarization to confirm the odd-parity nature. Here, we show that the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction provides a unified magnetic probe for both tasks. Taking collinear f-wave magnets as a representative example, we find that the RKKY interaction yields distinct magnetic signals of the spin splitting---including a magnetism reversal in the Heisenberg/Ising terms and a sign alternation of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) term---that enable clear discrimination of collinear f-wave magnets from other related AFMs. Moreover, the DM term exhibits an f-wave shape with odd-parity symmetry, satisfying JαβDM(R) = -JαβDM(C₂qR) (q=3), which directly reflects the odd-parity spin polarization S_z(k) = -S_z(C₂qk) in momentum space. This behavior persists in p-wave magnets (q=1), demonstrating the generality of our approach. Our work establishes the RKKY interaction as a versatile probe for detecting band features of collinear odd-parity magnets, with predictions accessible to existing experimental techniques such as spin-polarized scanning tunneling spectroscopy.

Temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent antiferromagnetic resonance measurements reveal the characteristic softening of the quasi-ferromagnetic (q-FM) resonance mode at the Γ₂ᵢ̊ghtarrowΓ₂₄ and Γ₂₄i̊ghtarrowΓ₄ transition points. In addition to the uniform q-FM mode, multiple magnon modes appear in the intermediate Γ₂₄ phase, separated by approximately 0.5--2 GHz and exhibiting similar field and temperature dependence. These additional modes are attributed to nonuniform spin-wave excitations arising from the periodic magnetic domain structure present in the intermediate phase and their hybridization with acoustic phonons mediated by strong magnetoelastic coupling. Our results demonstrate that the spin-reorientation transition in TmFeO₃ provides a natural platform for generating multiple hybridized magnon modes, offering new opportunities for tunable magnonic excitations in rare-earth orthoferrites.

arXiv:2603.29421v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期关于自旋惯性的提出与观测，以及由此产生的高频自旋章动模式，引发了关于我们对磁化动力学理解的关键问题，尤其是考虑到其与磁存储器和超快开关的高度相关性。尽管近期取得了进展，但仍有待明确识别自旋惯性的物理起源，从而提供预测能力。在此，我们讨论识别这一物理起源的一般原则，并考察未淬灭的轨道角动量（OAM），发现其虽通常数值较小，却是一个关键候选因素。我们在双子晶格模型中处理轨道角动量与自旋，并在作出适当近似的基础上推导出用于磁化动力学的等效单子晶格框架。后者自然呈现出通常以唯象方式引入的自旋惯性项和参数。在我们的模型中评估得到的惯性参数与钴中实验观测值高度一致。我们进一步勾勒出可验证或排除未淬灭轨道角动量作为所观测高频模式起源的关键实验特征，并避免将双子晶格铁磁体中的伪光学模式误识别为章动。我们的分析为新近兴起的轨道电子学与自旋惯性领域之间提供了潜在联系，从而推动对二者交叉领域的研究。

English Abstract

arXiv:2603.29421v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The recent proposal and observation of spin inertia, and the consequent high-frequency spin nutation mode, have raised key questions for our understanding of magnetization dynamics, especially considering its high relevance for magnetic memories and ultrafast switching. Notwithstanding recent progress, a clear identification of spin inertia's physical origin thereby offering predictive power remains to be accomplished. Here, discussing general principles for identifying this physical origin, we examine unquenched orbital angular momentum (OAM) finding it to be a key candidate, despite its typically small value. Treating OAM and spin within a two-sublattice model, we derive the equivalent single-sublattice framework for magnetization dynamics making appropriate approximations. The latter naturally manifests the spin inertia term and parameter, which are otherwise introduced phenomenologically. The inertia parameter evaluated within our model is found to be in good agreement with its experimentally observed value in cobalt. We further delineate key experimental signatures that could verify or rule out the unquenched OAM as the origin of the observed high-frequency mode, and avoid a spurious optical mode in a two-sublattice ferromagnet from being identified as nutation. Our analysis offers a potential link between the recently emerged fields of orbitronics and spin inertia, thereby motivating investigations at their intersection.

arXiv:2604.07112v2 发布类型：替换 摘要：铁电开关为控制电子结构提供了一种非易失性方式，但目前仍缺乏一种将两个可切换极化态的完整布洛赫能带联系起来的普适对称性规则。本文提出铁电能带孪生这一概念，它描述了一种对态关系：两个相反极化态的能带可通过一种非反演的态交换对称性相互映射。利用二色群，我们推导出能带孪生规则，并识别出11类铁电能带孪生点群。对铁电材料数据库进行筛选后得到16种候选化合物，其中两种保持晶格度量的候选体——体相 γ-Ag3SI 和 BaAl2O4——被选作第一性原理验证。对于 γ-Ag3SI，我们进一步表明，同样的对态对称性还控制着极化反转下位移电流张量分量的变换。这些结果确立了铁电能带孪生作为一种通用对称性框架，可用于实现对铁电体中动量依赖电子结构的非易失性调控。

English Abstract

arXiv:2604.07112v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ferroelectric switching provides a nonvolatile way to control electronic structures, but a general symmetry rule connecting the full Bloch bands of two switchable polarization states is still lacking. Here, we introduce ferroelectric band twinning, a pair-state relation in which the bands of two opposite-polarization states are mapped onto each other by a non-inversion state-exchange symmetry. Using dichromatic groups, we derive the band-twinning rule and identify 11 ferroelectric band-twinning point-group classes. Screening the Ferroelectric Materials Database yields 16 candidate compounds, of which the two lattice-metric-preserving candidates, bulk gamma-Ag3SI and BaAl2O4, are selected for first-principles validation. For gamma-Ag3SI, we further show that the same pair-state symmetry controls the transformation of shift-current tensor components under polarization reversal. These results establish ferroelectric band twinning as a general symmetry framework for nonvolatile control of momentum-dependent electronic structures in ferroelectrics.

arXiv:2605.01686v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：由非相对论交换场产生的费米面自旋分裂为拓扑超导性提供了一条不依赖强自旋轨道耦合的新途径。在此，我们研究了具有同位和最近邻吸引相互作用的方格晶格 p 波磁体中的超导不稳定性。奇宇称交换场消除了自旋分裂电子结构中的反演对称性，在单一对称性通道内混合单态和三重态序参量。主导的不稳定性是一个混合宇称的 A₁ Ising 态，其中单态组分与 pₓ 波三重态组分共存，且其 d 向量锁定在交换场轴方向。随着最近邻吸引增强，该 Ising 态将转变为具有节点的拓扑超导相，其马约拉纳边缘模受动量分辨绕数保护。这些模延伸于有限动量区间内，其范围由体点节点在表面的投影所界定。我们进一步表明，与交换场垂直的塞曼场可诱导出 Z₂ 拓扑超导相。我们的结果表明，p 波磁体是一个多用途的测试平台，可用于研究由非相对论自旋分裂驱动的拓扑超导性。

English Abstract

arXiv:2605.01686v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fermi-surface spin splitting generated by non-relativistic exchange fields provides a new route to topological superconductivity without relying on strong spin-orbit coupling. Here, we study superconducting instabilities of a square-lattice p-wave magnet with onsite and nearest-neighbour attractive interactions. The odd-parity exchange field removes inversion symmetry in the spin-split electronic structure, mixing singlet and triplet order parameters within a single symmetry channel. The leading instability is a mixed-parity A₁ Ising state, in which singlet components coexist with the pₓ₋wave triplet component, whose d-vector is locked along the exchange-field axis. As the nearest-neighbour attraction grows, this Ising state undergoes a transition into a nodal topological superconducting phase with Majorana edge modes protected by momentum-resolved winding numbers. These modes extend over finite momentum intervals bounded by the surface projections of bulk point nodes. We further show that a Zeeman field perpendicular to the exchange field can induce a Z₂ topological superconducting phase. Our results identify p-wave magnets as a versatile testbed for topological superconductivity driven by non-relativistic spin splitting.

arXiv:2605.21767v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们利用第一性原理密度泛函理论预测了六方 LaN 中的一种反极性不稳定性。以非极性六方相为起点，我们识别出相互竞争的极性和反极性区中心声子不稳定性。极性模和反极性模的凝聚分别稳定了动力学稳定的纤锌矿（WZ）相和六方反极性（AP）相；后者的特征是在晶胞内呈交替的局域极化，并且净宏观极化为零。在常压条件下，AP 相相对于 WZ 相为亚稳态，且这两个相之间存在有限能垒，表明可能存在通过 AP 中间态实现极化翻转的路径。WZ 相与 AP 相之间的能垒随压力升高而降低，表明极性态与反极性态之间的可调控性增强。AP 相中的子晶格极化随压力增加而增大，而在 WZ 相中则随压力增加而减小。我们进一步发现，随着压力升高，LaN 的岩盐相和四方相比六方相（AP 和 WZ）更稳定。因此，在六方相仍具有能量竞争力的低压区间，实现 AP 相更为有利。这些结果表明，LaN 中极性相与反极性相之间存在由压力驱动的竞争，并指向这一二元氮化物体系中的类反铁电行为。

English Abstract

arXiv:2605.21767v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We predict an antipolar instability in hexagonal LaN using first-principles density functional theory. Starting from a nonpolar hexagonal phase, we identify competing polar and antipolar zone-center phonon instabilities. Condensation of the polar and antipolar modes stabilizes, respectively, dynamically stable wurtzite (WZ) phase and an hexagonal antipolar (AP) phase which is characterized by alternating local polarization and zero net macroscopic polarization within the unit cell. At ambient conditions, the AP phase is metastable with respect to the WZ phase, and a finite energy barrier exists between these phases, suggesting a possible polarization-switching pathway via the AP intermediate state. The energy barrier between the WZ and AP phases decreases with increasing pressure, indicating enhanced tunability between polar and antipolar states. The sublattice polarization increases with pressure in the AP phase, while it decreases in the WZ phase. We further find that, with increasing pressure, the rock-salt and tetragonal phases of LaN become more stable than the hexagonal phases (AP and WZ). Consequently, the realization of the AP phase is more favorable in the low-pressure regime, where hexagonal phases remain energetically competitive. These results demonstrate pressure-driven competition between polar and antipolar phases in LaN and point toward antiferroelectric-like behavior in this binary nitride system.

English Abstract

arXiv:2605.30316v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electron doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene at high displacement field features an exceptionally flat band minimum with near-ideal quantum geometry. Experiments in this regime observe the formation of a 'quarter metal,' in which the electron liquid condenses into a single spin- and valley flavor. Remarkably, recent experiments have found a zero resistance state in the same region of the density- and displacement-field-tuned parameter space, attributed to the formation of a chiral superconductor from an orbitally ferromagnetic normal state. Here, we use nanoSQUID-on-tip magnetometry to map the orbital magnetization of electron-doped rhombohedral graphene devices ranging in thickness between 3 and 15 layers. Magnetization within the quarter metal phases peaks at finite density, consistent with concentration of the Berry curvature in a finite-momentum 'ring of fire'. Correlating transport and local magnetometry data in a superconducting tetralayer sample reveals a finite orbital ferromagnetic moment, providing direct evidence of valley polarization in the superconducting ground state. We further show that widely observed stochastic switching of the resistivity in both metallic and superconducting regimes arises from a density-tuned sign change in the valley-resolved total magnetic moment. This leads to the formation of metastable magnetic domains under typical gate control sequences and can also be harnessed for electric-field controlled switching of the magnetization across the entire device. Finally, high resolution measurements of the magnetization across a superconducting transition allow us to put an upper bound on the 'condensation magnetization' of 0.1 Bohr magneton per carrier, placing a strong quantitative restriction on theoretical models for ferromagnetic superconductivity.

中文摘要

利用强太赫兹（THz）脉冲操纵低能激发，为超快控制材料的电子和磁性性质提供了一种强有力的方法。理论表明，由THz场驱动的圆形离子运动携带角动量，并可能产生内部磁场。近期在非磁性SrTiO₃（STO）中的实验暗示了这种THz诱导的场，但其起源仍有争议。本文采用超快X射线衍射，解析了STO在圆偏振THz脉冲激发后的离子轨迹的时间演化。我们的分析表明，尽管氧离子的质量较小，但它们贡献了约90%的声子角动量。由此产生的带负电与带正电离子之间的不平衡，为STO中诱导磁性的机制提供了清晰解释。该工作还首次定量测量了圆形离子运动及其角动量，并建立了一种研究固体中角动量传递的通用方法，为控制拓扑声子输运和量子材料中的声子驱动磁性开辟了新策略。

English Abstract

arXiv:2607.01841v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The use of intense terahertz (THz) pulses to manipulate low-energy excitations offers a powerful approach for ultrafast control of electronic and magnetic properties in materials. Theory suggests that circular ionic motions driven by THz fields carry angular momentum, potentially generating internal magnetic fields. Recent experiments in nonmagnetic SrTiO3 (STO) have hinted at such THz-induced fields, but their origin remains debated. Here, we employ ultrafast x-ray diffraction to resolve the time-dependent ionic trajectories in STO following excitation by circularly polarized THz pulses. Our analysis reveals that oxygen ions, despite their lower mass, contribute around 90% of the phonon angular momentum. The resulting imbalance between the negatively and positively charged ions provides a clear explanation for the mechanism behind induced magnetism in STO. This work further provides the first quantitative measurement of circular ionic motions and their angular momentum and establishes a general methodology for the investigation of angular momentum transfer in solids, paving the way for new strategies to control topological phonon transport and phonon-driven magnetism in quantum materials.

中文摘要

在具有强相互作用的低密度体系中，电子预期会结晶形成维格纳固体。近年来，在电子携带贝里曲率的二维体系方面的进展为维格纳结晶增添了拓扑维度。利用拓扑维格纳晶体中赝自旋相互作用的模型，我们在此表明，三角晶格上铁磁海森堡交换 J 与手性相互作用 γ 之间的竞争稳定了一种零场斯格明子晶体，其密度可通过 γ/J 的比值连续调节。手性相互作用源自底层时间反演破缺维格纳晶体中的有限贝里曲率。在连续极限中，手性相互作用充当斯格明子的化学势，而非线性 sigma 模型之外的高阶梯度项选择斯格明子密度。在大的手性耦合下，我们发现一种含 24 个格点的四重斯格明子晶体，其每个磁性原胞携带四个单位的拓扑荷，并在 J → 0 时与四子晶格四面体有序发生简并。我们表征了这些相的磁振子结构，并讨论了可调斯格明子晶体向大 γ/J 下这些态转变的过程。我们的结果确立了铁磁拓扑维格纳晶体的相图。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In low density systems with strong interactions electrons are expected to crystallize into a Wigner solid. Recently, advances in two-dimensional systems where electrons carry Berry curvature have added a topological dimension to Wigner crystallization. Using a model for pseudospin interactions in a topological Wigner crystal, here we show that the competition between ferromagnetic Heisenberg exchange J and the chiral interaction γ on the triangular lattice stabilizes a zero-field skyrmion crystal whose density is continuously tunable through the ratio γ/J. The chiral interaction originates from finite Berry curvature in an underlying time-reversal broken Wigner crystal. In the continuum limit, the chiral interaction acts as a chemical potential for skyrmions, while higher-order gradient terms beyond the nonlinear sigma model select the skyrmion density. At large chiral coupling, we uncover a 24-site tetra-skyrmion crystal carrying four units of topological charge per magnetic unit cell, which becomes degenerate with four-sublattice tetrahedral order as J → 0. We characterize the magnon structure for these phases and discuss the transition between the tunable skyrmion crystal to these states at large γ/J. Our results establish the phase diagram of ferromagnetic topological Wigner crystals.

中文摘要

交替磁体结合了补偿的反铁磁有序与动量依赖自旋劈裂，为无需宏观磁化或杂散磁场的自旋电子学应用提供了有前景的平台。尽管已经识别出大量三维（3D）材料作为交替磁体，二维（2D）交替磁体仍相对有限。在这项工作中，我们对 Materials Cloud 2D Crystals（MC2D）数据库中的 2710 种材料进行了交替磁性的高通量计算搜索。我们的方法将基于对称性的筛选与第一性原理密度泛函理论计算相结合，并包含自洽 Hubbard-U 修正，以可靠地捕捉磁性基态。通过系统探索磁构型及其能量稳定性，我们识别出 42 种材料在至少一个 U 值下表现出交替磁性基态，其中 24 种在从第一性原理确定 Hubbard-U 参数后仍保持稳健——包括文献中此前报道的 4 种材料和 20 种新预测候选材料。这些材料包括有前景的单层材料，如金属性 Fe₂Si₂SbO₉ 和绝缘性 CoBrO，其自旋劈裂分别约为 294 meV 和 330 meV。我们的结果显著扩展了具有有利剥离能学性质的潜在二维交替磁体候选材料库，并为实验工作提供了有价值的指导。此外，本工作建立了一个用于交替磁性材料可重复发现和表征的高通量计算框架。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated antiferromagnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, offering a promising platform for spintronic applications without macroscopic magnetization or stray magnetic fields. Although a wide range of three-dimensional (3D) materials have been identified as altermagnets, two-dimensional (2D) altermagnets remain comparatively limited. In this work, we perform a high-throughput computational search for altermagnetism across 2710 materials in the Materials Cloud 2D Crystals (MC2D) database. Our approach combines symmetry-based screening with first-principles density functional theory calculations, including self-consistent Hubbard-U corrections, to reliably capture magnetic ground states. Through a systematic exploration of magnetic configurations and their energetic stability, we identify 42 materials exhibiting altermagnetic ground states for at least one value of U, of which 24 remain robust upon determination of the Hubbard-U parameters from first principles--including 4 materials previously reported in the literature and 20 newly predicted candidates. These comprise promising monolayers such as metallic Fe₂Si₂SbO₉, and insulating CoBrO, with spin splittings about 294 meV and 330 meV, respectively. Our results significantly expand the pool of potential 2D altermagnet candidates with favorable exfoliation energetics and provide valuable guidance for experimental efforts. In addition, this work establishes a high-throughput computational framework for reproducible discovery and characterization of altermagnetic materials.

我们通过将多变量变分蒙特卡罗方法应用于空穴掺杂的 t-J 型 Kitaev 模型，研究掺杂 Kitaev 量子自旋液体中的超导性。利用能够精确表示 Kitaev 量子自旋液体的投影成对乘积波函数，我们考察了各向同性二维团簇上超导相的稳定性。对于铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用，稳健的三重态 p 波超导在低至中等掺杂区域与铁磁性共存，但随着系统接近完全极化铁磁相而受到抑制。对于反铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用，超导性表现出主导配对对称性的变化，即从低掺杂下的自旋依赖三重态 p 波转变为中等掺杂下的单重态 d+id。通过在固定掺杂下改变铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用的强度，我们表明三重态超导随铁磁矩一起增强，并在略低于完全极化时达到最强。我们的结果为在载流子掺杂 Kitaev 候选材料中实验寻找非常规超导性，例如与铁磁性共存的三重态超导，提供了理论基础。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.03024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate superconductivity in a doped Kitaev quantum spin liquid by applying the many-variable variational Monte Carlo method to the hole-doped t-J-type Kitaev model. Using a projected pair-product wave function that can exactly represent the Kitaev quantum spin liquid, we examine the stability of superconducting phases on isotropic two-dimensional clusters. For the ferromagnetic Kitaev interaction, robust triplet p-wave superconductivity coexists with ferromagnetism in the low-to-intermediate doping regime but is suppressed as the system approaches the fully polarized ferromagnetic phase. For the antiferromagnetic Kitaev interaction, superconductivity exhibits a change in the dominant pairing symmetry from spin-dependent triplet p-wave at low doping to singlet d+id at intermediate doping. By varying the strength of the ferromagnetic Kitaev interaction at fixed doping, we show that the triplet superconductivity increases together with the ferromagnetic moment and becomes strongest slightly below full polarization. Our results provide a theoretical basis for experimental searches for unconventional superconductivity, such as triplet superconductivity coexisting with ferromagnetism, in carrier-doped Kitaev candidate materials.

中文摘要

二维范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe₂（F3GT）和 Fe₅GeTe₂（F5GT）表现出显著的磁光响应，为研究晶格、电子和磁自由度之间的相互作用提供了有前景的平台。在这里，我们利用波长和温度依赖的螺旋度分辨拉曼光谱，对这些体系中由光学共振诱导的各向异性电子-声子耦合及其与磁有序的关联进行了比较研究。通过在左旋和右旋圆偏振激发下分辨二重简并的 E 模，我们证明手性模劈裂（Δf）的温度演化并不追踪磁化行为，这表明螺旋度依赖的拉曼响应并非仅源自磁有序导致的时间反演对称性破缺，还源自自旋-轨道耦合的电子相互作用。值得注意的是，在 F3GT 中，面外磁化在光学共振下间接支配面内各向异性电子-声子耦合，而 F5GT 则表现出静态各向异性相互作用。Fano 不对称参数 1/q 揭示了声子与电子连续谱之间具有模式和温度依赖的耦合强度，其中 F3GT 具有显著的角向各向异性，而 F5GT 表现出各向同性行为——这是后者具有多个 Fe 位点和增强层间杂化的结果。我们的结果展示了晶体结构和磁各向异性在塑造这些层状金属铁磁体中各向异性耦合的电子-声子-自旋动力学方面的作用，并突出了 FeₓGeTe₂ 作为获取层状金属铁磁体中手性光-物质相互作用微观认识的多功能平台。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.03193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnets Fe₃GeTe ₂ (F3GT) and Fe₅GeTe₂ (F5GT) exhibit pronounced magneto-optical responses, which open promising platforms for investigating the interplay among lattice, electronic, and magnetic degrees of freedom. Here, we present a comparative study of optical resonance-induced anisotropic electron-phonon coupling and its association with magnetic ordering in these systems using wavelength- and temperature-dependent helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy. By resolving the doubly degenerate E modes under left- and right-circularly polarized excitations, we demonstrate that the temperature evolution of the chiral mode splitting (Δ f) does not track the magnetization behavior, indicating that the helicity-dependent Raman response arises not solely from time-reversal symmetry breaking due to magnetic order, but also from spin-orbit-coupled electronic interactions. Notably, in F3GT, the out-of-plane magnetization indirectly governs the in-plane anisotropic electron-phonon coupling under optical resonance, whereas F5GT exhibits static anisotropic interactions. The Fano asymmetry parameter 1/q reveals mode- and temperature-dependent coupling strengths between phonons and the electronic continuum, with pronounced angular anisotropy in F3GT but isotropic behavior in F5GT--- a consequence of its multiple Fe sites and enhanced interlayer hybridization in the latter. Our results demonstrate the role of crystal structure and magnetic anisotropy in shaping the anisotropically coupled electron-phonon-spin dynamics in these layered metallic ferromagnets, and highlight FeₓGeTe₂ as a versatile platform for microscopic insight into chiral light-matter interactions in layered metallic ferromagnets.

稀土基石榴石为研究超 kagome 晶格中受挫驱动的磁性性质提供了可行平台。在此，我们通过磁化、热容和非弹性中子散射（INS）测量，报告了属于石榴石家族的一种新的 Nd³⁺ 基超 kagome 反铁磁体 Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂ 的磁性性质和晶体电场（CEF）方案的综合研究。磁化测量显示存在主导的反铁磁相互作用，其低温居里-外斯温度 θ_CW^LT ≃ -0.2 K。在磁场下，磁热容数据中观察到两个宽峰，意味着由于 CEF 影响产生的多能级 Schottky 异常，并显示出两步磁熵释放。低至 0.1 K 未观察到磁长程有序。通过 INS 实验探测到的、具有 D₂ 点群对称性的 Nd³⁺（J=9/2）离子的 CEF 激发表现为非色散激发，表征 CEF 能级之间的跃迁。对不同温度下 INS 谱的同时拟合使我们能够确定 CEF 哈密顿量和 Kramers 双重态的能量本征值。利用所得 CEF 参数进行的模拟再现了实验磁化率、磁等温线和磁热容数据。热力学性质和 INS 得到的晶体场方案证实，低温下基态为具有有效自旋 Jₑff = 1/2 的 Kramers 双重态。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.03365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth based garnets provide a viable platform for studying the frustrated driven magnetic properties of the hyperkagome lattices. Herein, we report a comprehensive study of the magnetic properties and crystal electric field (CEF) scheme of a new Nd³⁺ based hyperkagome antiferromagnet, Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂ belonging to the garnet family via magnetization, heat capacity, and inelastic neutron scattering (INS) measurements. Magnetization measurement reveals a dominant antiferromagnetic interaction with a low temperature Curie-Weiss temperature θₘ̊ CWm̊ LT simeq -0.2 K. Two broad maxima are observed in the magnetic heat capacity data under magnetic fields, implying multilevel Schottky anomalies due to the effect of CEF and display a two-step magnetic entropy release. No magnetic long-range order is observed down to 0.1 K. The CEF excitations of the Nd³⁺ (J=9/2) ion with D₂ point group symmetry, probed via INS experiments, show non-dispersive excitations characterizing the transitions among the CEF energy levels. The simultaneous fit of the INS spectra at different temperatures enabled the mapping of the CEF Hamiltonian and the energy eigenvalues of the Kramers' doublets. The simulation using the obtained CEF parameters reproduces the experimental magnetic susceptibility, magnetic isotherms, and magnetic heat capacity data. The thermodynamic properties and INS-derived crystal-field scheme confirm a Kramers' doublet ground state with an effective spin Jₘ̊ ₑff = 1/2 at low temperatures.
