中文摘要

硬约束循环物理信息网络（HRPINNs）将已知动力学嵌入循环数值积分器中，并将神经分支限制为仅学习第一性原理模型未捕捉到的残余动力学。Kolmogorov--Arnold 网络（KANs）已被提出作为此类残差分支中多层感知机（MLPs）的参数高效替代方案，但其可学习的 B 样条激活遵循显著不同的执行特征。基于先前工作，该工作刻画了普通 B 样条 KAN 作为 HRPINN 残差分支在发现精度上何时匹配或低于 MLP，本文提出的问题是这种参数效率是否能够在部署中保持。使用相同的训练权重，我们在一个没有向量扩展的 RISC-V RV64GC 平台（StarFive VisionFive 2，SiFive U74）上的闭合循环递归回路中，测量了执行延迟、每个积分步的能量以及后训练量化下的可靠性。对于两组精度可比的配对，KAN 残差分支执行速度分别慢 13.5 倍和 8.0 倍，每个积分步消耗能量分别高 11.3 倍和 5.6 倍（最小配对为 3.7 μJ，而 MLP 为 0.33 μJ）；在所有四个参数匹配的规模层级中，这些范围分别为 4.7 倍--14.5 倍和 4.7 倍--18.7 倍。在 INT8 量化下，KAN 轨迹比匹配的 MLP 最多提前 43 倍发散；损害可追溯到权重量化，而不是输入侧结点区间误分配。这些结果表明，KAN 所报告的参数效率并不会转移为标量嵌入式核心上的部署成本优势，并且除非采用特定的量化协同设计，否则 MLP 残差分支是嵌入式 HRPINN 部署中更可靠的默认选择。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hard-constrained recurrent physics-informed networks (HRPINNs) embed known dynamics inside a recurrent numerical integrator and restrict a neural branch to learning only the residual dynamics that the first-principles model does not capture. Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have been proposed as parameter-efficient replacements for multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in such residual branches, but their learnable B-spline activations follow a markedly different execution profile. Building on prior work that characterized when a vanilla B-spline KAN matches or underperforms an MLP as an HRPINN residual branch in discovery accuracy, this paper asks whether that parameter efficiency survives deployment. Using identical trained weights, we measured execution latency, energy per integration step, and dependability under post-training quantization in the closed recurrent loop on a RISC-V RV64GC platform without vector extensions (StarFive VisionFive~2, SiFive U74). For the two accuracy-comparable pairs, the KAN residual branch executed 13.5× and 8.0× slower and consumed 11.3× and 5.6× more energy per integration step (3.7,μJ against 0.33,μJ for the smallest pair); across all four parameter-matched size tiers the ranges are 4.7×--14.5× and 4.7×--18.7×. Under INT8 quantization, KAN trajectories diverged up to 43× earlier than matched MLPs; the damage traces to weight quantization, not to input-side knot-interval misassignment. These results indicate that the parameter efficiency reported for KANs does not transfer to deployment cost on scalar embedded cores, and that an MLP residual branch is the more dependable default for embedded HRPINN deployment unless specific quantization co-design is used.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.01160v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：拓扑神经网络（TNNs）能够利用图上的高阶结构（例如环和团）来增强消息传递神经网络的表达能力。然而，这些结构通常通过无监督的图提升操作预先识别。尽管如此，这一选择至关重要，并可能对 TNN 在下游任务中的性能产生显著影响。为规避这一问题，我们提出 partiallift（DiffLift），一种以端到端方式学习图提升到超图以及胞腔复形和单纯复形的通用框架。具体而言，我们的方法利用学习得到的顶点级潜在表示来识别并参数化候选高阶胞元的纳入概率分布。这使得模型具有良好的可扩展性，并可轻松集成到任何 TNN 中。我们的实验表明，partiallift 在多个图分类和节点分类基准上、跨不同 TNN 架构均优于现有的提升方法。值得注意的是，我们的方法相较于静态提升带来了最高达 45% 的性能提升，其中包括基于连通性和基于特征的提升方法。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological neural networks (TNNs) enable leveraging high-order structures on graphs (e.g., cycles and cliques) to boost the expressive power of message-passing neural networks. In turn, however, these structures are typically identified a priori through an unsupervised graph lifting operation. Notwithstanding, this choice is crucial and may have a drastic impact on a TNN's performance on downstream tasks. To circumvent this issue, we propose partiallift (DiffLift), a general framework for learning graph liftings to hypergraphs and cellular- and simplicial complexes in an end-to-end fashion. In particular, our approach leverages learned vertex-level latent representations to identify and parameterize distributions over candidate higher-order cells for inclusion. This results in a scalable model which can be readily integrated into any TNN. Our experiments show that partiallift outperforms existing lifting methods on multiple benchmarks for graph and node classification across different TNN architectures. Notably, our approach leads to gains of up to 45% over static liftings, including both connectivity- and feature-based ones.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.01357v1 公告类型：新摘要：传统逼近理论以参数个数或自由度来衡量收敛速率。然而，实际计算受限于有限精度：参数必须用有限比特数进行编码。因此，逼近效率应以计算比特复杂度来评估，而这与底层函数类的度量熵本质相关。本文基于二进制编码和度量熵，建立了一个统一的逼近框架。我们分析了经典方法（包括多项式逼近、稀疏网格和有限元）以及浅层和深层神经网络，并在函数类具有可比度量熵的条件下比较它们的逼近速率。我们观察到，当以比特为尺度评估时，大多数经典方法通常相对于由度量熵所规定的内在极限而言并非最优，而神经网络方法则可能呈现不同的行为。我们证明，当复杂度以比特而非参数来度量时，没有任何方法在本质上能够超越经典方法所达到的逼近阶。此外，我们的结果还表明，神经网络的许多表面优势，包括与维数无关的速率和超收敛现象，源于函数类复杂度的差异，而非架构本身的内在优越性。从这个意义上说，传统的维数灾难可能具有误导性；真正的根本限制是比特复杂度灾难，它由度量熵所支配。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traditional approximation theory measures convergence rates in terms of the number of parameters or degrees of freedom. However, practical computation operates under finite precision: parameters must be encoded using a finite number of bits. Therefore, approximation efficiency should be evaluated in terms of computational bit complexity, which is intrinsically connected to the metric entropy of the underlying function class. In this work, we develop a unified approximation framework based on binary encoding and metric entropy. We analyze classical methods (including polynomial approximation, sparse grids, and finite elements) as well as shallow and deep neural networks, and compare their approximation rates for function classes with comparable metric entropy. We observe that, when evaluated in terms of bits, most classical methods are in general suboptimal relative to the intrinsic limits dictated by metric entropy, while neural network methods may exhibit different behaviors. We show that when complexity is measured in bits rather than parameters, no method fundamentally exceeds the approximation order achieved by classical approaches. Our results also indicate that many seeming advantages of neural networks, including dimension-independent rates and superconvergence phenomena, stem from differences in function class complexity rather than intrinsic architectural superiority. In this sense, the traditional curse of dimensionality can be misleading; the fundamental limitation is instead a curse of bit complexity, governed by metric entropy.

arXiv:2608.01378v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：化学、材料科学和机器学习中的设计活动共享一个瓶颈：确定一个候选对象究竟有多好，需要昂贵的评估——一次实验、一次第一性原理模拟，或一次完整的训练运行。用于预测这些结果的机器学习替代模型正日益不仅被用来提出候选对象，也被用来给它们评分，甚至将自身的预测反馈回搜索过程，仿佛这些预测就是测量结果。通过数学分析，并在三个已被穷尽获得真实基准的设计任务上加以验证，我们确定了这种做法何时是安全的、任何安全证书必须付出何种代价，以及何时这种替代能够被证明是有收益的。预测准确性无法支撑信任：近乎完美的 R² 仍可能与最差可能的选择并存；而筛选 N 个候选对象会以可量化的“选择税”放大被选中候选对象处的过度预测，并且该税具有相匹配的上下界。安全性反而来自一条架构规则——预测可以不受限制地用于提出候选对象和训练，但每一个经认证的结论都必须建立在真实评估之上——这一规则在不对替代模型作任何假设的情况下是充分的，并且也是必要的，因为若允许预测以测量结果的地位进入认证，就会开启一种确定性的自我确认失效模式。我们推导出模型可充当预言机的最小准则（保持排序，而非准确性），表明信任必须通过选择感知的审计来购买，且这种审计在查询复杂度上是最优的，并证明了一个二分结论，用以确定经审计的替代模型何时能够降低经认证的评估成本。在六种任务—机制条件下的 432 次替代模型拟合中，审计统计量以 0.80–0.99 的 Spearman 秩相关跟踪实际部署的搜索性能，而 R² 与部署后遗憾值的秩相关最低降至 0.33；经审计的筛选使经认证的预言机成本实测降低了 25 倍。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Design campaigns in chemistry, materials science, and machine learning share a bottleneck: determining how good a candidate truly is requires an expensive evaluation - an experiment, a first-principles simulation, or a full training run. Machine-learning surrogates that predict these outcomes are increasingly used not only to propose candidates but to grade them, and even to feed their own predictions back into the search as though they were measurements. Through mathematical analysis validated on three exhaustively ground-truthed design tasks, we establish when this practice is safe, what any certificate of safety must cost, and when the substitution provably pays. Predictive accuracy cannot anchor trust: near-perfect R² is compatible with worst-possible selections, and screening N candidates inflates the over-prediction at the selected candidate by a quantifiable "selection tax" with matching upper and lower bounds. Safety follows instead from an architectural rule - predictions may propose and train without restriction, but every certified conclusion must rest on true evaluations - which is sufficient with no assumptions on the surrogate, and necessary, since admitting predictions into certification with the standing of measurements opens a deterministic self-confirmation failure mode. We derive the minimal criterion under which a model may act as an oracle (rank preservation, not accuracy), show that trust must be purchased through selection-aware audits that are optimal in query complexity, and prove a dichotomy fixing when audited surrogates cut certified evaluation cost. Across 432 surrogate fits over six task-regime conditions, the audit statistic tracks deployed search performance at Spearman rank correlation 0.80-0.99, while the rank correlation of R² with deployed regret falls as low as 0.33; audited screening reduces certified oracle cost by a measured factor of 25.

arXiv:2608.01793v1 发布类型：新 摘要：统一异常检测需要在无法获取异常样本的情况下对高度异质的正常数据进行建模。尽管 DINOv2 等基础模型提供了丰富的 token 表示，但如何在这些空间中进行显式密度估计仍然具有挑战性。基于能量的模型（EBMs）提供了一种有原则的建模框架，但其在高维 token 空间中的训练由于各向异性和强跨维相关性而不稳定，从而削弱了有限步马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）采样的效果。我们将这种不稳定性识别为本质上的几何问题，并提出 ReFP-AD（用于异常检测的整流流预条件化），其通过一个与最优传输（OT）耦合的整流流学习几何重参数化，将高维嵌入映射到一个条件良好的潜在空间中。该预条件化使得能够在全维 token 空间中，利用预条件化随机梯度朗之万动力学（SGLD）进行稳定的持续对比散度训练。随后，异常分数通过梯度范数从所学习的能量景观中推导得到。在 MVTec-AD 和 VisA 数据集上的严格统一协议下，ReFP-AD 在 MVTec-AD 上分别取得 98.6%/97.9% 的图像/像素 AUROC，在 VisA 上分别取得 97.3%/99.0% 的图像/像素 AUROC，相比此前的统一 EBM 基线，图像 AUROC 最高提升达 +10.8%。消融实验表明，几何重参数化对于高维 token 空间中的有限步 MCMC 以及准确的异常定位至关重要。代码可在 https://github.com/CLendering/ReFP-AD 获取

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unified anomaly detection requires modeling highly heterogeneous normal data without access to anomalous samples. While foundation models like DINOv2 provide rich token representations, leveraging these spaces for explicit density estimation remains challenging. Energy-Based Models (EBMs) offer a principled formulation, but their training in high-dimensional token spaces is unstable due to anisotropy and strong cross-dimensional correlations, which degrades finite-step Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling. We identify this instability as fundamentally geometric and introduce ReFP-AD (Rectified Flow Preconditioning for Anomaly Detection), which learns a geometric reparameterization that maps high-dimensional embeddings into a well-conditioned latent space via an optimal transport (OT)-coupled rectified flow. This preconditioning enables stable persistent contrastive divergence with preconditioned Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) in full-dimensional token spaces. Anomaly scores are then derived from the learned energy landscape using gradient norms. Under a strict unified protocol on the MVTec-AD and VisA datasets, ReFP-AD achieves 98.6%/97.9% Image/Pixel AUROC on MVTec-AD and 97.3%/99.0% on VisA, outperforming prior unified EBM baselines by up to +10.8% in Image AUROC. Ablation experiments demonstrate that geometric reparameterization is critical for finite-step MCMC and accurate anomaly localization in high-dimensional token spaces. Code is available at https://github.com/CLendering/ReFP-AD

arXiv:2608.02027v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：我们介绍 scikit-fingerprints，这是一个基于 RDKit、全面且完全兼容 scikit-learn 的 Python 分子机器学习库。分子指纹及其相关功能是化学信息学的核心工具，然而广泛使用的开源框架并不兼容基于 scikit-learn 约定的更广泛的 Python 机器学习生态系统。scikit-fingerprints 弥合了这一差距，将分子指纹、分子过滤器、相似性和距离度量、适用域估计、数据划分策略等功能整合到一个统一且熟悉的接口之下。与 scikit-learn 的兼容性意味着，从原始 SMILES 字符串到可部署模型的整个化学信息学工作流程，都可以由可组合的构建模块组装而成，并可复用周边生态系统中成熟的工具。底层 RDKit 代码使其对于自定义化学信息学应用场景而言既熟悉又易于扩展。我们重点关注统一接口、易用性、计算效率、可定制性和可扩展性。scikit-fingerprints 使分子机器学习的原型开发更快、结果更易复现，并且部署更简单。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present scikit-fingerprints, a comprehensive, fully scikit-learn compatible library for molecular machine learning in Python, based on RDKit. Molecular fingerprints and related functionalities are workhorses of chemoinformatics, yet the widely used open-source frameworks are not compatible with the wider Python machine learning ecosystem based on scikit-learn conventions. scikit-fingerprints closes this gap, bringing molecular fingerprints, molecular filters, similarity and distance measures, applicability domain estimation, data splitting strategies, and more under a single, familiar interface. Scikit-learn compatibility means that an entire chemoinformatics workflow, from a raw SMILES string to a deployable model, can be assembled from composable building blocks and can reuse the mature tooling of the surrounding ecosystem. The underlying RDKit code makes it familiar and extensible for custom chemoinformatics use cases. We put a strong focus on unified interfaces, ease of use, computational efficiency, customization, and extensibility. scikit-fingerprints makes molecular machine learning faster to prototype, easier to reproduce, and simpler to deploy.

arXiv:2608.02064v1 公告类型：新 摘要：前馈网络（FFN）占 Transformer 参数的很大一部分，然而其隐藏宽度通常在深度上保持不变。我们探讨这种容量是否可以改由前向传播中对层行为的度量来分配。我们将每个 FFN 视为传递一个 token 表示点云，并在原始度量和尺度归一化度量下，使用保持对应关系的位移、Gromov-Wasserstein 畸变以及一阶持久同调来量化其所引起的几何变化。一种逐层近似代理可导出一个精确的固定预算优化器。在七个预训练语言模型上，原始欧氏工作量在很大程度上跟随残差范数增长，而归一化工作量则主要前置。与有限样本的拓扑估计相比，Gromov-Wasserstein 工作量与基于扰动的层敏感性的关联更为一致。在配对的 1.28 亿和 2.56 亿参数训练运行中，若干归一化工作量调度相较于均匀宽度和手工设计的余弦收缩均可降低平均验证损失。在 4.4 亿参数下放大后的配对差异中，最佳的基于几何的分配相较于均匀分配的提升明显大于余弦收缩，而反拓扑的原始对照则劣于均匀分配。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) account for a large fraction of Transformer parameters, yet their hidden width is usually constant across depth. We ask whether this capacity can instead be allocated from a forward-pass measurement of layer behavior. We view each FFN as transporting a cloud of token representations and quantify the induced geometric change using correspondence-preserving shift, Gromov-Wasserstein distortion, and degree-one persistent homology under raw and scale-normalized metrics. A layerwise approximation surrogate yields an exact fixed-budget optimizer. Across seven pretrained language models, raw Euclidean work largely tracks residual-norm growth, whereas normalized work is predominantly front-loaded. Gromov-Wasserstein work is more consistently associated with perturbation-based layer sensitivity than the finite-sample topological estimate. In paired 128M and 256M training runs, several normalized-work schedules reduce mean validation loss relative to both uniform width and a hand-designed cosine taper. With the amplified paired differences at 440M, the best geometry-based allocations improve over uniform substantially larger than the cosine taper, while the anti-topological raw control is worse than uniform.

arXiv:2608.02088v1 公告类型：新

摘要：可靠的光伏（PV）预测是低碳能源系统所必需的，但新部署站点往往只有较短且不完备的历史记录。这使得标准日前预测变得困难：持续性基线和物理基线可能对校准和时间戳对齐敏感，而单一机器学习模型可能只捕捉数据中的一种结构，并在非时序验证下夸大预测技能。我们在英国一个充电站站点研究这一问题，该站点的光伏预测误差会影响充电可用性、储能调度和下游控制。利用实测逆变器输出和公开可得的气象输入，我们开发了一个面向部署的环境-AI流程，用于日前小时级光伏预测。该流程校正时间戳约定，构建无信息泄漏的太阳几何与晴空指数特征，增加短期大气背景信息，并通过经验证学习的堆叠集成组合互补预测器。与智能持续性基线相比，这一基线通过利用近期光伏输出并结合预期晴空辐照度进行调整，在随机按日分块评估下，最佳集成将白天归一化RMSE降低约32%，在更严格的滚动起点协议下降低9%。相较于最强的单一机器学习基线，它还分别将白天RMSE降低了6.6%和6.4%。结果表明，考虑物理知识的堆叠集成可以支持基于有限站点数据的光伏预测，但其价值取决于模型类别、评估协议和部署情境。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable photovoltaic (PV) forecasts are needed for low-carbon energy systems, but newly deployed sites often have short, imperfect records. This makes standard day-ahead forecasting difficult: persistence and physical baselines can be sensitive to calibration and timestamp alignment, while single machine-learning models may capture only one structure in the data and overstate skill under non-temporal validation. We study this problem at a United Kingdom charging-station site, where PV forecast errors affect charging availability, storage scheduling, and downstream control. Using measured inverter output and publicly available meteorological inputs, we develop a deployment-oriented environmental-AI pipeline for day-ahead hourly PV forecasting. The pipeline corrects timestamp conventions, constructs leakage-safe solar-geometry and clearness-index features, adds short-term atmospheric context, and combines complementary predictors through validation-learned stacking. Against smart persistence, a clear-sky baseline that adjusts recent PV output using expected clear-sky irradiance, the best ensemble reduces daylight normalised RMSE by about 32% under random day-blocked evaluation and 9% under the stricter rolling-origin protocol. It also reduces daylight RMSE relative to the strongest individual machine-learning baseline by 6.6% and 6.4%, respectively. The results show that physics-aware stacking can support PV forecasts from limited site data, but its value depends on model class, evaluation protocol, and deployment context.

arXiv:2608.02157v1 公告类型：新 摘要：拉曼光谱能够在材料科学、生物医学和过程监测中实现无损、无标记的分子表征。用于预测的拉曼数据集通常仅包含少量带标注光谱和数千个有序波数，且信息性变化既存在于谱带内部，也存在于相距较远的光谱区域之间。潜变量化学计量学能够处理共线性小样本数据，但可能掩盖精细的峰形态；而深度光谱网络只有在针对特定任务训练后才能解析这种结构。TabPFN 通过预训练的上下文推理避免针对特定任务的参数拟合，但它将极宽输入处理为特征子采样视图，无法保持相关谱带的联合可见性。我们提出 RamanPFN，这是一种在 TabPFN 推理之前对这些依赖关系进行编码的光谱表示框架。全局组分解混构建覆盖完整光谱的非负坐标，使具有共享潜在变化的远距离谱带占据同一预测轴。局部振动子空间编码使用多个正交模态表示连续波数区域，以保留峰形、强度和位置的独立变化。这些表示在预测层面分别评估并组合。评估涵盖 74 个公开拉曼数据集中的 150 个任务。相较于直接 TabPFN 推理，RamanPFN 在 129 个回归目标上的均方根误差平均降低 19.6%，并在 21 个分类任务上将剩余分类误差进一步降低 9.0%。这些结果表明，显式光谱表示可作为高维拉曼测量与可复用表格推理之间的有效接口。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Raman spectroscopy enables non-destructive, label-free molecular characterization across materials science, biomedicine and process monitoring. Predictive Raman datasets often contain few labelled spectra and thousands of ordered wavenumbers, with informative variation within bands and across distant spectral regions. Latent-variable chemometrics accommodates collinear small-sample data but can obscure fine peak morphology, whereas deep spectral networks resolve this structure only after task-specific training. TabPFN avoids task-specific parameter fitting through pretrained in-context inference, but processes very wide inputs as feature-subsampled views that do not preserve joint visibility of related bands. We present RamanPFN, a spectral representation framework that encodes these dependencies before TabPFN inference. Global Compositional Unmixing constructs non-negative coordinates over the complete spectrum so that distant bands with shared latent variation occupy a common predictive axis. Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding represents contiguous wavenumber regions with multiple orthogonal modes that retain independent changes in peak shape, intensity and position. The representations are evaluated separately and combined at the prediction level. Evaluation covered 150 tasks from 74 public Raman datasets. RamanPFN reduced root-mean-square error by 19.6% on average across 129 regression targets relative to direct TabPFN inference and further reduced the remaining classification error by 9.0% across 21 classification tasks. These results establish explicit spectral representation as an effective interface between high-dimensional Raman measurements and reusable tabular inference.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.02168v1 公告类型：新 摘要：信用风险检测，尤其是缓解个人欺诈，对于维护数字金融生态系统的稳定至关重要。在数十亿用户中准确识别信用欺诈，对于最小化财务损失和保障普惠金融服务的可持续性至关重要。鉴于信用欺诈风险往往隐藏在异构的用户-风险图中，图神经网络（GNN）通过捕获复杂依赖关系，已成为一种有效的风险挖掘工具。为应对工业级 GNN 的可扩展性瓶颈，基于子图的分布式训练不可或缺。然而，现有策略在负载均衡方面往往以牺牲拓扑完整性为代价。这对于风险检测而言可能是灾难性的，因为它会不加区分地切断对风险传播至关重要的长尾证据链。重叠子图可以恢复被切断的风险上下文，但不可避免地会引入冗余和噪声，同时忽视不同局部子图之间的表示对齐。本文提出了一种面向大规模信用风险检测的风险感知重叠子图学习框架。我们首先构建基础划分以确保负载均衡。随后，执行预算约束采样，选择具有信息量的长尾节点，从而在过滤噪声的同时保留关键的风险扩散模式。为缓解表示不一致性，我们设计了一种跨子图一致性对齐机制。通过对重叠节点施加对齐约束，我们将局部表示协调到一个全局一致的潜在空间中。在微信支付生产数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的模型显著优于现有的风险检测策略，为工业图学习提供了一种可扩展且有效的解决方案。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Credit risk detection, particularly mitigating individual fraud, is crucial for maintaining the stability of digital financial ecosystems. Accurately identifying credit fraud among billions of users is critical for minimizing financial losses and safeguarding the sustainability of inclusive financial services. Given that credit fraud risks are often concealed within heterogeneous user-risk graphs, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as an effective tool for risk mining by capturing complex dependencies. To address the scalability bottleneck of industrial GNNs, distributed training based on subgraphs is indispensable. However, existing strategies often compromise topological integrity for load balancing. This can be catastrophic for risk detection, as it indiscriminately severs the long-tail evidence chains essential for risk propagation. Overlapping subgraphs can restore severed risk contexts but inevitably introduce redundancy and noise, while overlooking the representation alignment across different local subgraphs. In this paper, we propose a risk-aware overlapping subgraph learning framework for large-scale credit risk detection. We first construct base partitions to ensure load balance. Then, we perform budget-constrained sampling that selects informative long-tail nodes, thereby preserving critical risk diffusion patterns while filtering out noise. To mitigate representation inconsistency, we design a cross-subgraph consistency alignment mechanism. By enforcing alignment constraints on the overlapping nodes, we harmonize the local representations into a globally consistent latent space. Extensive experiments on Weixin Pay's production dataset demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms existing strategies for risk detection, offering a scalable and effective solution for industrial graph learning.

arXiv:2608.02352v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：原生计算机使用为智能体提供了一种通用接口，使其能够操作人们可用的几乎任何软件，但这需要长时程状态跟踪、大规模交互式经验，以及从稀疏但可验证的结果中学习。我们提出 Qwen-CUA，这是一种原生计算机使用智能体，采用 397B-A17B 的 Qwen 混合专家骨干模型。它仅观察屏幕截图，并通过键盘和鼠标事件执行操作，不依赖 DOM 树、可访问性元数据或任务特定 API。其脚手架最多维护 20 张活动屏幕截图，并将更早的视觉历史按固定大小的块进行折叠，以在保留近期证据的同时保持可复用的提示前缀。为进行训练，我们构建了一个云端 rollout 集群，可访问近 100,000 个 vCPU 和数万个并发环境，构建了约 40,000 个可验证任务，并在日常与专业软件中收集个性化的长时程工作流。我们利用可验证奖励和轨迹切片来优化完整轨迹，同时通过迭代训练运行刷新监督数据并重新校准强化学习任务。在八个基准测试中，Qwen-CUA 的表现优于 Qwen3.7，并与领先的专有系统保持竞争力，在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 86.2，在 OSWorld 2.0 上二元/部分完成率达到 18.5/48.4。将相同方法扩展到超过一万亿参数的模型后得到 Qwen-CUA-Max，使这些分数提升至 87.6 和 21.2/53.3。相较于 Qwen3.7，Qwen-CUA 还将 RedTeamCUA 攻击成功率从 36.6 降至 16.4。效率分析、浏览器部署以及 Bash 增强实验进一步刻画了其实践行为。这些结果确立了原生计算机使用作为一种具备广泛能力的智能体基础，并凸显了可扩展的可验证交互和混合工具使用是关键方向。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its scaffold maintains up to 20 active screenshots and folds older visual history in fixed-size blocks to retain recent evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes. For training, we build a cloud rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments, construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks, and collect personalized long-horizon workflows across everyday and professional software. We optimize complete trajectories with verifiable rewards and trajectory slicing, while iterative training runs refresh supervised data and recalibrate reinforcement-learning tasks. Across eight benchmarks, Qwen-CUA outperforms Qwen3.7 and remains competitive with leading proprietary systems, reaching 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified and 18.5/48.4 binary/partial completion on OSWorld 2.0. Scaling the same recipe to a model with over one trillion parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, improving these scores to 87.6 and 21.2/53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7. Efficiency analyses, a browser deployment, and Bash-augmented experiments further characterize practical behavior. These results establish native computer use as a broadly capable agent foundation and highlight scalable verifiable interaction and hybrid tool use as key directions.

arXiv:2608.00048v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：脑电图（EEG）生成对于缓解数据稀缺并在脑机接口应用中实现大规模神经建模至关重要。然而，现有的基于流的方法假设一个样本中的每个通道和每个时间片段共享单一的全局时间进程，忽视了并非所有 EEG 时刻都是等同的这一事实。为了解决这种被忽视的异质性，我们提出了一种基于条件流匹配的自适应 EEG 生成框架。该框架引入了位置自适应时间调度，通过跟踪每个位置的重构误差来调节流匹配轨迹中特定于位置的时间进程。它进一步结合了因子化时空注意力以及频率对齐的多分辨率谱一致性损失，以建模由容积传导引起的通道间依赖关系，并补偿 EEG 的幂律谱偏置，从而提高生成信号的质量。在三个具有不同采集协议和任务语义的 EEG 数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的框架持续优于最强基线，使 TS-FID 最高降低 62.2%，并使下游分类准确率增益最高提高 6.77 个百分点。这些结果表明，所提出的方法代表了面向真实世界脑机接口应用的可扩展、高保真数据增强迈出的有前景的一步。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00048v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) generation is essential for alleviating data scarcity and enabling large scale neural modeling in brain computer interface applications. However, existing flow based approaches assume that every channel and every time segment within a sample shares a single global time progression, overlooking the fact that not all EEG moments are equal. To address this overlooked heterogeneity, we propose an adaptive EEG generation framework built on conditional flow matching. The framework introduces Position-Adaptive Time Scheduling, which tracks per position reconstruction error to modulate a position specific time progress within the flow matching trajectory. It further incorporates Factorized Spatio-Temporal Attention and a frequency aligned multi resolution spectral consistency loss to model inter channel dependencies induced by volume conduction and compensate for the power law spectral bias of EEG, thereby improving the quality of generated signals. Extensive experiments on three EEG datasets with distinct acquisition protocols and task semantics show that our framework consistently outperforms the strongest baseline, reducing TS-FID by up to 62.2% and improving downstream classification accuracy gain by up to 6.77 percentage points. These results suggest that the proposed method represents a promising step toward scalable, high fidelity data augmentation for real world brain computer interface applications.

arXiv:2608.00053v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：离散傅里叶变换、离散余弦变换及其分块变体支撑着大多数已部署的图像和视频编解码器。它们的有效性依赖于三个性质：它们以近线性时间运行（在线性时间基础上至多相差一个多对数因子）、精确可逆，并且几乎不含参数。在这项工作中，我们将这些基推广为等距多线性基，在保持上述三个性质的同时，允许引入少量额外参数，其数量关于图像大小呈多对数增长。给定一个图像数据集，我们提出了一个系统性框架，在该族中搜索能够最有效压缩该数据集的基：该基被参数化为一个受量子多体理论启发的等距张量网络，并在酉矩阵流形上通过黎曼优化进行训练。在自然照片和线条绘图上，训练得到的基始终优于其固定的非参数对应物。在 Quick Draw 线条绘图压缩任务中，在相同重建质量下，与 JPEG 的 8 × 8 分块余弦变换相比，它们存储图像所需的字节数约减少 20%。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00053v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Discrete Fourier Transform, the Discrete Cosine Transform, and their block-wise variants underpin most deployed image and video codecs. Their effectiveness rests on three properties: they run in near-linear time (linear up to a polylogarithmic factor), they are exactly invertible, and they carry few to no parameters. In this work, we generalize these bases to isometric multilinear bases, allowing a small number of extra parameters, polylogarithmic in the image size, while preserving all three properties. Given an image dataset, we develop a systematic framework that searches this family for the basis compressing the dataset most effectively: the basis is parameterized as an isometric tensor network, inspired by quantum many-body theory, and trained with Riemannian optimization on the manifold of unitary matrices. Across natural photographs and line drawings, the trained bases consistently improve on their fixed, non-parametric counterparts. On Quick Draw line-drawing compression, they store images in roughly 20% fewer bytes than JPEG's 8 × 8 block cosine transform at the same reconstruction quality.

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00406v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate indoor localization is essential for emerging applications in robotic navigation and search and rescue. While classical methods typically focus on single-point estimates, complex indoor environments with heavy blockage and multipath propagation often lead to multimodal likelihood surfaces where a single estimate is insufficient. This paper proposes LOCUS-DT (Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins), a framework that treats snapshot localization as posterior inference over the transmitter location. By leveraging a ray-tracing-based digital twin (DT) of the known environment, LOCUS-DT generates synthetic multipath profiles for candidate locations and compares them against the measured channel profile. Central to our approach is a novel learned scoring function designed to compare a fixed number of dominant specular paths, providing robustness against errors in both the DT environment model and the physical channel estimation. Importantly, LOCUS-DT is trained over an ensemble of environments to ensure generalization to unseen layouts. We evaluate the system using a Sionna-based ray-tracing backend, demonstrating that LOCUS-DT captures the sharp, multimodal posterior structures inherent in indoor settings more accurately than standard Gaussian or Gaussian-mixture benchmarks.

arXiv:2608.00027v1 公告类型：新摘要：高效的长序列建模仍然是大型语言模型的核心挑战，因为自注意力机制的计算复杂度随序列长度呈二次增长。Mamba 通过选择性状态空间递归提供了一种线性时间的替代方案，但其主要为对角形式的状态转移限制了状态维度之间的显式交互。我们提出 Motif-Mamba，这是一种结构化状态空间模型，它通过一种受 motif 约束的低秩递归通路增强 Mamba。该通路受三节点网络 motif 动力学的启发，将隐藏状态投影到一个紧凑的动力子空间中，引入 motif 引导的交互，并将所得动力学映射回原始状态空间。该设计在保持 Mamba 线性时间递归结构的同时，增强了跨维度通信能力。在长序列外推、语言建模基准以及脑机接口解码上的实验表明，相较于 Mamba 主干模型，该方法具有一致的性能提升，说明 motif 引导的低秩动力学为长程序列建模提供了一种有效的结构先验。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.

摘要：神经组合优化（NCO）技术已成为求解旅行商问题（TSP）等路径规划问题的传统精确算法的一种高效替代方案。然而，当扩展到高维实例时，这些基于强化学习的模型的泛化能力会受到严重制约。通过采用自监督预训练策略，这一问题在计算机视觉和自然语言处理等其他领域已得到缓解。尽管如此，由于路由图除了二维空间坐标之外缺乏复杂的拓扑属性，其应用于路由图仍然面临挑战。本文提出了一种专门设计的几何自监督预训练框架，用于捕捉空间不变性和全局相对距离分布。通过施加等距变换，如旋转和轴反射，模型在策略优化阶段之前学习稳健的结构表示。实证结果表明，该策略始终优于从头训练的模型（基线），在大规模零样本外推场景（TSP1,000）中巡回长度提升了 7.23%。此外，所提出的模型表现出显著的计算效率，在大规模场景下，相较于精确求解器 Concorde 可实现高达两个数量级的加速。源代码和预训练模型已公开发布于：https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git。

arXiv:2608.00270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales. The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git.

摘要：尺度定律的发现凸显了人工智能系统的非凡潜力，其显著的经验模式是：随着 AI 系统规模扩大，其能力往往可预测地提升。然而，在现实应用中，AI 很少独立运行；相反，它通常与人类协同工作，这就引出了一个问题：这些收益在人人工智能协作中是否仍能持续。在本研究中，我们构建了一个解析模型，用以考察 AI 的经验性规模收益何时能够转化为人机联合系统绩效的提升。我们表明，只要人类对 AI 能力具有准确认知，人机系统的绩效就可以随着 AI 规模扩张而正向增长。然而，人类的误判会从根本上改变这一关系：i）当人类高估 AI 能力时，可能出现规模悖论，即更大的 AI 规模反而降低整体系统绩效，并放大企业层面的利润损失；ii）当人类低估 AI 能力时，绩效仍会随规模提升而改善，但增速显著更慢。我们进一步表明，企业可以通过成本内部化和认知对齐等运营政策主动管理这些偏差，而这些政策的有效性取决于 AI 部署的经济性以及人类误判的方向。这些发现表明，与其单纯投资更大、更昂贵的 AI 系统，组织或许更能从管理人机接口中获益。更广泛地看，我们的结果表明，AI 规模扩张不仅应被视为技术挑战，也应被视为行为与运营挑战，并且提醒人们警惕这样一种观点：更大的 AI 系统会自动带来更好的运营结果。AI 规模扩张是否创造价值，最终取决于能力提升如何塑造人类信念与协作努力。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00818v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of scaling laws has highlighted the extraordinary potential of AI systems with a striking empirical pattern: as AI systems scale, their capabilities tend to improve predictably. Yet, in real-world applications, AI rarely operates in isolation; instead, it often works alongside humans, raising the question of whether these gains persist in human-AI collaboration. In this work, we develop an analytical model to examine when the empirical scaling benefits of AI translate into improved human-AI joint system performance. We demonstrate that the performance of a human-AI system can scale positively as the AI scales up-provided that humans have an accurate perception of the AI's capabilities. Human misperception, however, can fundamentally alter this relationship: i) when humans over-perceive the AI's capabilities, a scaling paradox may arise, in which greater AI scale reduces overall system performance and amplifies firm-level profit losses, and (ii) when humans under-perceive the AI's capabilities, performance still improves with scale but at a substantially slower rate. We further show that firms can actively manage these distortions through operational policies such as cost internalization and perception alignment, whose effectiveness depends on the economics of AI deployment and the direction of human misperception. These findings suggest that organizations may benefit more from managing the human-AI interface than from simply investing in larger, more expensive AI systems. More broadly, our results suggest that AI scaling should be viewed not only as a technological challenge, but also as a behavioral and operational one, and caution against the view that larger AI systems will automatically lead to better operational outcomes. Whether AI scaling creates value ultimately depends on how increased AI capabilities shape human beliefs and collaborative efforts.

arXiv:2608.01197v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：去中心化联邦学习（Decentralized Federated Learning，DFL）已成为一种最优的隐私保护解决方案；然而，由于缺乏中央协调者，它仍然容易受到机会主义行为的影响。尽管演化博弈论（Evolutionary Game Theory，EGT）是分析此类行为的有力框架，但现有研究通常假设智能体具有完全理性并保持静态策略。为解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种新颖的演化博弈论框架，旨在分析策略演化并提升整体系统性能。本文的主要贡献有三点：首先，我们在有限理性假设下，对格状网络结构中的点对点（peer-to-peer，P2P）交互进行建模。其次，我们构建了一个综合收益矩阵，将训练成本、通信开销和合作奖励纳入其中，同时定制了一种策略更新规则，以刻画空间传播动态。第三，我们引入了一种基于声誉的奖惩机制，以有效遏制搭便车行为。仿真结果表明，该框架显著优于基线方法。具体而言，它将平均准确率从约 70% 提高到 82%，将合作频率提升至接近 100%（相比之下，基线方法低于 5%），并将准确率方差从约 0.40 降至 0.002，从而加速一致收敛并确保系统稳定性。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) has emerged as an optimal privacy-preserving solution; however, it remains vulnerable to opportunistic behaviors due to the absence of a central coordinator. While Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) serves as a powerful framework for analyzing such behaviors, existing studies often assume that agents possess perfect rationality and maintain static strategies. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel EGT framework designed to analyze strategic evolution and enhance overall system performance. The primary contributions of this work are threefold: First, we model peer-to-peer (P2P) interactions on a lattice network structure under the assumption of bounded rationality. Second, we formulate a comprehensive payoff matrix incorporating training costs, communication overhead, and cooperative rewards, while tailoring a strategy update rule that captures spatial propagation dynamics. Third, we integrate a reputation-based reward-and-punishment mechanism to effectively deter free-riding behaviors. Simulation results demonstrate that the framework significantly outperforms the baseline. Specifically, it increases average accuracy from approximately 70% to 82%, elevates cooperation frequency to approach 100% (compared to below 5% in the baseline), and drops accuracy variance from around 0.40 to 0.002, thereby accelerating uniform convergence and ensuring system stability.

arXiv:2608.01234v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型智能体日益在动态环境中运行，在这些环境中，工具接口、API 和用户需求会在部署后发生变化。现有的自进化方法主要遵循两种范式：基于外壳的方法将反馈外化为可编辑的记忆或技能，以实现快速适应；基于参数的方法则将经验内化到模型参数中，以实现更深层次的能力提升。然而，仅使用任一机制都会在灵活性与性能之间产生权衡。本文探讨智能体如何协调这两种通道以实现稳健的自进化。我们提出 COVE，一个统一的智能体自进化框架，通过任务感知路由、阶段感知调度和知识优化，将基于外壳的学习与基于参数的学习结合起来。通过这一设计，COVE 将自进化视为一个协调过程，而非对经验的无差别积累；该过程会将任务和知识类型匹配到适当的学习机制。跨多个任务类别的实验表明，COVE 优于单通道进化策略，在变化环境下展现出更稳健且更高效的改进。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly operate in dynamic environments where tool interfaces, APIs, and user requirements change after deployment. Existing self-evolution methods mainly follow two paradigms: harness-based approaches, which externalize feedback into editable memories or skills for rapid adaptation, and parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters for deeper capability improvement. However, using either mechanism alone creates a trade-off between flexibility and performance. This paper asks how an agent can coordinate both channels to achieve robust self-evolution. We present COVE, a unified agent self-evolution framework that combines harness-based and parameter-based learning through task-aware routing, stage-aware scheduling, and knowledge optimization. Through this design, COVE treats self-evolution not as indiscriminate accumulation of experience, but as a coordinated process that matches tasks and knowledge types to appropriate learning mechanisms. Experiments across multiple task categories show that COVE outperforms single-channel evolution strategies, demonstrating more robust and efficient improvement under changing environments.

arXiv:2608.01344v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：第一阶段仿星器设计在一个高维的三维等离子体边界族和固定边界磁流体动力学（MHD）平衡中搜索构型，以共同满足对约束、磁力线拓扑、力平衡、稳定性代理指标和几何形状的要求。这些规格并不能提供一种通向经验证有限 β 平衡的一般构造性映射。高质量目标通常通过迭代数值优化来形成，其结果取决于初始构型、启用的傅里叶分辨率、目标优先级以及局部求解器预算。协调这一过程计算成本高且高度依赖专家，限制了设计吞吐量以及一致评估数据的生成。我们提出了智能体式第一阶段优化的概念验证。一个受限语言模型智能体诊断当前平衡并选择下一次局部优化实验，而确定性的 DESC 执行负责规定的剖面和通量、对称性、度量评估、求解器有效性以及接受判定。在一项不断扩展的有限 β 研究活动中抽取的共同预算子集上，满足门控有效性的构型数量从 5 个输入增加到 19 个输出；Boozer 准对称性（QS）均方根的中位数从 2.39×10⁻⁴ 降至 1.07×10⁻⁴，最大主曲率的中位数从 62.56 降至 33.00 m⁻¹。一条互补的长路径在修复磁井和曲率缺陷的同时，实现了 QS 降低 9.10 倍。该系统还将每一次尝试的局部动作记录为转移证据，在所报告的实验中产生了 734 条结构化的父节点—动作—结果记录。这些结果表明，智能体外环控制能够维持有限 β、多目标搜索，并将重复优化转化为一种可扩展的改进平衡与可复用决策数据来源。

arXiv:2608.01344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stage-one stellarator design searches a high-dimensional family of three-dimensional plasma boundaries and fixed-boundary MHD equilibria for configurations that jointly meet requirements on confinement, field-line topology, force balance, stability proxies, and geometry. These specifications do not provide a general constructive map to a validated finite-beta equilibrium. High-quality targets are commonly developed through iterative numerical optimization whose outcome depends on the initial configuration, active Fourier resolution, objective priorities, and local solver budget. Coordinating this process is computationally costly and expert-intensive, limiting both design throughput and the production of consistently evaluated data. We present a proof of concept for emphagentic stage-one optimization. A bounded language-model agent diagnoses the current equilibrium and selects the next local optimization experiment, while deterministic DESC execution owns prescribed profiles and flux, symmetry, metric evaluation, solver validity, and acceptance. On a common-budget subset from an expanding finite-beta campaign, the number of gate-valid configurations increases from five inputs to nineteen outputs; median Boozer QS RMS decreases from 2.39×10⁻⁴ to 1.07×10⁻⁴, and median maximum principal curvature decreases from 62.56 to 33.00,m⁻¹. A complementary long route achieves a 9.10× QS reduction while repairing magnetic-well and curvature defects. The system also records every attempted local action as transition evidence, yielding 734 structured parent--action--outcome records in the reported experiments. These results show that agentic outer-loop control can sustain finite-beta, multi-objective search and turn repeated optimization into a scalable source of improved equilibria and reusable decision data.

摘要：多模态持续指令微调（Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning，MCIT）使多模态大语言模型能够按顺序学习新任务，同时保留先前习得的能力。近期许多方法维护任务特定的 LoRA 专家，并在推理时将每个输入路由到一个或多个专家。然而，支撑专家路由的任务识别问题仍未得到充分研究。我们表明，在广泛使用的 MCIT 基准上，路由几乎已经饱和。泄露任务身份的文本指纹，以及仅包含 4--10 个任务且竞争专家较少的短任务序列，共同掩盖了长程路由问题。为揭示这一挑战，我们提出 FLEX（Fingerprint-reduced Long-horizon Expert eXamination，弱化指纹的长程专家检验），这是一个具有 34 个任务的长程 MCIT 基准，削弱了文本指纹。FLEX 将具有相似指令和答案格式、但视觉与知识领域多样的任务进行分组，对其外层模板进行归一化，并在显著更大的专家池上评估路由。关键的是，我们将渐进式 LoRA 路由形式化为软任务即类别的多模态类别增量学习（Multimodal Class-Incremental Learning，MCIL）：每个任务定义一个增量路由类别，其完整得分分布提供 LoRA 混合权重，而硬路由则是其离散特例。FLEX 使这一不断扩展的任务识别挑战得以显现，而 MCIL 形式化则为将 CIL 方法迁移到专家路由提供了一个原则性的接口。我们构建了 PureLoRA 作为受控基线，并在不修改其 LoRA 专家或生成流水线的前提下，将四种 CIL 方法适配到四种 MCIT 框架中。我们的即插即用路由器将严格 LoRA 匹配最高提升 16.3 个百分点，并将整体 MacroScore 最高提升 4.6 分。代码地址：https://github.com/RINC-CL/FLEX

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables multimodal large language models to acquire new tasks sequentially while retaining previously learned capabilities. Many recent methods maintain task-specific LoRA experts and route each input to one or more experts at inference. Yet the task-identification problem underlying expert routing remains under-explored. We show that routing is nearly saturated on widely used MCIT benchmarks. Textual fingerprints that leak task identity and short 4--10-task sequences with few competing experts jointly obscure the long-horizon routing problem. To expose this challenge, we introduce FLEX (Fingerprint-reduced Long-horizon Expert eXamination), a 34-task long-horizon MCIT benchmark with weakened textual fingerprints. FLEX groups tasks with similar instruction and answer formats but diverse visual and knowledge domains, normalizes their outer templates, and evaluates routing over a substantially larger expert pool. Crucially, we formulate progressive-LoRA routing as soft task-as-class Multimodal Class-Incremental Learning (MCIL): each task defines an incremental routing class, whose complete score distribution supplies the LoRA mixture weights, with hard routing as a discrete special case. FLEX exposes this expanding task-identification challenge, while the MCIL formulation provides a principled interface for transferring CIL methods to expert routing. We instantiate PureLoRA as a controlled baseline and adapt four CIL methods to four MCIT frameworks without modifying their LoRA experts or generation pipelines. Our plug-in routers improve strict LoRA matching by up to 16.3 percentage points and overall MacroScore by up to 4.6 points. Code is available at: https://github.com/RINC-CL/FLEX

arXiv:2608.01548v1 发布类型：新论文
摘要：语言可被视为思维的形式化子集：一种由更广泛的情境认知投射而来的、受后果支配的符号结构。大规模训练的大语言模型表现出补偿性涌现：稀疏的架构原语支持上下文学习、多步推理、工具使用和思维链。然而，相较于人类认知，一种以语言为先的概率架构继承了实质性、底层和高层的不完备性。二者并存，使得 LLM 成为一种类人思维形式生成器，能够从不完备底座中重建出越来越类人的推理形式。我们提出问题：涌现是否能够补偿所有缺失的区分？我们将这一哲学前提形式化为“符号化—子结构论题”，并引入涌现不变性。对于一个通过共享任务接口 φ 作用的、按尺度索引的家族，Rₛ^*=R_φ^*+Cₛ：尺度可以降低补偿差距 Cₛ，而正的接口下限 R_φ^* 依然存在。我们证明，在固定输入律下，一个接口在信息上普遍不少于另一个接口，当且仅当其完备信息 σ-代数细化了对方；并且，总补偿当且仅当接口下限与渐近补偿差距均为零。该框架统一了关于落地、记忆、位置、注意力、贝叶斯继承、科学溯因与推理控制的既有结果。在一项匹配的 DeepSeek V4-Flash API 研究中，当相关区分可用时，thinking 将指针追踪任务表现从 0/16 提升至 14/16；精确的观测孪生体仍停留在其 50% 的构造下限；而恢复关键记忆则使匹配性能从 50% 提升至 100%。这些结果为所预测的“接口内扩展”与“接口本身细化”之间的分离提供了初步证据。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language can be viewed as a formalized subset of thought: a consequence-governed symbolic structure projected from wider situated cognition. Large language models trained at scale exhibit compensatory emergence: sparse architectural primitives support in-context learning, multi-step reasoning, tool use, and chain of thought. Yet a language-first probabilistic architecture inherits substantive, substrate, and high-level incompletenesses relative to human cognition. Their coexistence makes an LLM a human-like thought-form generator that reconstructs increasingly human-like reasoning forms from an incomplete substrate. We ask whether emergence can compensate for every missing distinction. We formalize the philosophical premise as the Symbolization--Substructure Thesis and introduce emergence invariance. For a scale-indexed family acting through a shared task interface φ, Rₛ^*=R_φ^*+Cₛ: scale can reduce the compensation gap Cₛ, while a positive interface floor R_φ^* persists. We prove that, under a fixed input law, one interface is universally no less informative exactly when its completed information σ-field refines the other, and that total compensation occurs exactly when both the interface floor and asymptotic compensation gap vanish. The framework unifies existing results on grounding, memory, position, attention, Bayesian inheritance, scientific abduction, and reasoning control. In a matched DeepSeek V4-Flash API study, thinking improves pointer chasing from 0/16 to 14/16 when relevant distinctions are available; exact observational twins remain at their 50% construction floor; and restoring decisive memory moves matched performance from 50% to 100%. These results provide initial evidence for the predicted separation between scaling within an interface and refining the interface itself.

arXiv:2608.01739v1 公告类型：new 摘要：随着记忆在跨任务和跨会话中不断累积，长程 LLM 智能体的性能同时依赖于面向特定查询的检索和持续的记忆精炼。然而，现有方法通常只优化其中之一：要么通过迭代式查询重写或自适应检索策略来优化记忆访问，要么通过结构更新等方式优化记忆演化。这种分离忽视了一个基本的反馈回路：检索决定哪些记忆获得使用信号，而更新后的记忆库又会重塑未来的检索。我们提出 CoEvo-Mem，一个用于检索策略与记忆库协同演化的闭环框架。对于每个查询，一个冻结的 LLM 生成面向路由的查询改写和路由先验，随后由一个轻量级残差路由器在线修正。检索到的上下文作为两种学习过程之间的耦合接口：任务结果对路由决策分配信用，而轨迹条件反馈则更新记忆值和图关系。这些更新会改变后续查询中记忆的排序与选择方式，从而闭合反馈回路。为缓解耦合引入的非平稳性，CoEvo-Mem 交替执行两步：在记忆库固定时更新路由器，以及在检索策略固定时演化记忆库。在七个多样化基准上，CoEvo-Mem 取得了最先进的性能，证明了检索-记忆协同演化的重要性。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As memories accumulate across tasks and sessions, the performance of long-term LLM agents depends jointly on query-specific retrieval and continual memory refinement. However, existing methods typically optimize either memory access, through iterative query refinement or adaptive retrieval policies, or memory evolution such as structural update. This separation overlooks a fundamental feedback loop: retrieval determines which memories receive usage signals, while updated memory bank reshape future retrieval. We propose CoEvo-Mem, a closed-loop framework for co-evolving the retrieval policy and memory bank. For each query, a frozen LLM generates route-specific query rewrites and a routing prior, which a lightweight residual router corrects online. The retrieved context serves as the coupling interface between the two learning processes: task outcomes assign credit to routing decisions, while trajectory-conditioned feedback updates memory values and graph relations. These updates alter how memories are ranked and selected for subsequent queries, thereby closing the feedback loop. To mitigate coupling induced non-stationarity, CoEvo-Mem alternates between updating the router with the memory bank fixed and evolving the memory bank with the retrieval policy fixed. Across seven diverse benchmarks, CoEvo-Mem achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the importance of retrieval-memory coevolution.

arXiv:2608.01850v1 通告类型：new 摘要：物理信息神经网络（PINNs）将稀疏观测与物理方程相结合，为复杂等离子体过程建模和未知物理量推断提供了重要途径。高约束模托卡马克中的陡峭梯度边缘区（pedestal）与等离子体约束和边界输运密切相关。分析该区域中的离子温度梯度（ITG）漂移波，需要联合识别复杂本征频率并重构二维复值模场。局域化的高频振荡、强实虚耦合以及模场与本征频率之间的非线性耦合，对 PINN 的表征能力和联合优化提出了挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种物理信息神经框架，结合傅里叶特征编码、复值特征传播和三阶段训练。在稀疏观测与物理约束下，该框架可联合求解代表性基态 ITG 分支的复本征频率和模场。实验表明，该框架能够准确恢复目标复本征频率和二维复值模场，并优于具有代表性的 PINN 基线方法。它还为分析更高阶和多分支漂移波模态提供了基础。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) combine sparse observations with physical equations, providing an important approach for modeling complex plasma processes and inferring unknown physical quantities. The steep-gradient pedestal of high-confinement-mode tokamaks is closely linked to plasma confinement and edge transport. Analyzing ion-temperature-gradient (ITG) drift waves in this region requires jointly identifying complex eigenfrequencies and reconstructing two-dimensional complex-valued mode fields. Localized high-frequency oscillations, strong real-imaginary coupling, and nonlinear coupling between the mode field and eigenfrequency challenge PINN representation and joint optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a physics-informed neural framework combining Fourier feature encoding, complex-valued feature propagation, and three-stage training. Under sparse observations and physical constraints, it jointly solves for the complex eigenfrequency and mode field of a representative ground-state ITG branch. Experiments show that the framework accurately recovers the target complex eigenfrequency and two-dimensional complex-valued mode field and outperforms representative PINN baselines. It also provides a basis for analyzing higher-order and multiple-branch drift-wave modes.

arXiv:2608.01995v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们研究了当单个通用大语言模型作为唯一研究者，处理一个长周期神经架构设计问题时会发生什么。该智能体接收一个科学问题、一个初始假设及其动机、一个计算预算以及研究可用条件（源码与实验管理、实验跟踪、文献访问和持久记忆），随后在较长时间内自主提出、实现、评估并记录实验。本研究包含三个阶段，各阶段由人工宣布的转换分隔，并逐步扩展智能体的工具接口或问题规模。在约 100 次连续实验中，该智能体将一个非标准 Vision Transformer 从较弱的基线改进为在小型基准上更强且高效的模型，并在 ImageNet-1K 上得到一个可用但低于当前最优水平的模型，同时生成了密集的行为轨迹。我们报告四项发现：（i）生产力呈现出清晰的阶段结构：早期快速提升、经历数十个假设后的饱和壁垒，以及恢复；其中恢复是由扩展行动空间而非改变底层模型所触发的。（ii）单个早期假设对准确率提升的贡献更大，而后续改进呈长尾分布。（iii）对贪婪式、渐进式假设的偏好在很大程度上由工作流诱发：一种提交或丢弃的评估规则与贪婪爬山法同构；其余部分则反映了大胆尝试失败后的风险规避，以及对熟悉文献的锚定。（iv）该智能体独立地重新发现了既有结果，并在其不熟悉的纯通道注意力情境中推翻了一项标准设计选择。我们得出结论，在本研究中，工作流设计至少与智能体能力同等重要，并提出多样化搜索、有预算约束的“登月式”假设、显式分叉以及面向情境的重新验证，作为未来自主研究可检验的方向。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study what happens when a single general-purpose large language model acts as the sole researcher on a long-horizon neural architecture design problem. The agent receives a scientific question, an initial hypothesis and motivation, a compute budget, and research affordances (source and experiment management, experiment tracking, literature access, and persistent memory), then autonomously proposes, implements, evaluates, and records experiments over an extended period. The study comprises three phases, separated by human-declared transitions, that progressively expand the agent's tool surface or problem scale. Across approximately 100 sequential experiments, the agent improves a non-standard Vision Transformer from a weak baseline to a stronger, efficient model on small benchmarks and a usable but sub-SOTA model on ImageNet-1K, while producing a dense behavioural trace. We report four findings.(i)Productivity exhibits a clear phase structure: rapid early gains, a multi-dozen-hypothesis saturation wall, and recovery, with recovery triggered by expanding the action surface rather than changing the underlying model.(ii)A single early hypothesis contributes more to accuracy gain, with later improvements long-tailed.(iii)The preference for greedy, incremental hypotheses is largely workflow-induced: a commit-or-discard evaluation rule is isomorphic to greedy hill-climbing; the remainder reflects risk aversion after bold failures and anchoring on familiar literature. (iv)The agent independently rediscovers established results and, in the unfamiliar regime of pure channel attention, overturns a standard design choice. We conclude that workflow design was at least as influential as agent capability in this study and propose diversified search, budgeted moonshot hypotheses, explicit forks, and regime-aware re-validation as testable directions for future autonomous research.

中文摘要

高熵合金（HEA）材料及其二维对应物（2D-HEAs）近来因其可调性质和催化潜力而受到关注，但其化学复杂性使直接密度泛函理论（DFT）计算在计算上代价过高。这种复杂性也使机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的训练具有挑战性，但通过采用通用 MLIPs 作为起点或许可以克服这一问题。在本工作中，我们研究了通用 MLIP 模型在二维过渡金属二硫属化物高熵合金中的适用性，并开发了有效的微调策略。训练结构被系统地生成和选择，并将通用模型和微调模型的性能与 DFT 进行基准比较。我们发现，本工作中采用的所有通用 MLIPs 在未经微调时给出的混合能均不令人满意。应用于实验合成的 (Mo,Ta,Nb,W,V)S₂ 体系时，基于枚举结构的微调模型能够在预测混合能方面达到接近 DFT 的精度，同时使蒙特卡洛模拟和随机结构采样能够在 DFT 无法达到的尺度上进行。

English Abstract

arXiv:2603.23029v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-entropy alloy (HEA) materials and their two-dimensional counterparts (2D-HEAs) have recently attracted attention due to their tunable properties and catalytic potential, yet their chemical complexity makes direct density functional theory (DFT) calculations computationally prohibitive. The complexity also makes training of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) challenging, but this could possibly be overcome by employing universal MLIPs as starting point. In this work, we investigate the applicability of universal MLIP models for 2D transition metal dichalcogenide HEAs and develop effective fine-tuning strategies. Training structures are systematically generated and selected, and the performance of universal and fine-tuned models are benchmarked against DFT. We find that all universal MLIPs employed in this work yield unsatisfactory mixing energies without fine-tuning. Applied to the experimentally synthesized (Mo,Ta,Nb,W,V)S₂ system, fine-tuned models based on enumerated structures can achieve near-DFT accuracy in predicting mixing energies while enabling Monte-Carlo simulations and random structure sampling at scales inaccessible to DFT.

arXiv:2605.16837v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：受物理启发的机器学习方法为从数据中发现本构模型提供了新的见解，帮助克服了传统本构建模的一些局限，同时降低了原本计算开销巨大的模拟成本。然而，许多现有方法要么只施加了相关物理和热力学结构的一部分约束，要么仅在特定本构类别内实现热力学一致性，这使得它们在广泛材料行为中的适用性以及在数据有限时对未见加载路径的泛化能力仍存在疑问。本文建立了一个用于从宏观应力-应变数据中学习非弹性本构模型的热力学约束学习框架。该框架基于非平衡热力学，对自由能和控制材料状态演化的广义输运算子同时进行参数化，并将材料客观性、能量平衡以及非负耗散作为硬性、可扩展的约束加以施加。包含简单应力-应变加载路径的解析基准测试表明，该方法能够为一系列复杂程度不断提高的非弹性材料学习到热力学一致且稳健的本构模型。在推断阶段，所得模型能够推广到更具挑战性的、未观测到的路径，并识别出可解释的内部变量，以表征路径依赖行为。随后，该框架被应用于颗粒介质，这类材料具有典型的非均匀性和历史依赖性。基于离散元方法的数值模拟实验进行训练后，该方法仅依赖宏观应力-应变历程，即可识别出可容许的本构方程，并预测循环加载下的响应，包括训练数据中未出现的滞回现象的产生。

English Abstract

arXiv:2605.16837v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning approaches informed by physics have offered new insights into the discovery of constitutive models from data, helping overcome some limitations of traditional constitutive modelling while reducing the cost of otherwise computationally intensive simulations. Yet, many existing methods either enforce only part of the relevant physical and thermodynamic structure, or achieve thermodynamic consistency within specific constitutive classes, leaving open questions about their applicability across a broad range of material behaviours and their ability to generalise to unseen loading paths when limited data are available. This work establishes a thermodynamics-constrained learning framework for inelastic constitutive models from macroscopic stress-strain data. The framework is based on non-equilibrium thermodynamics and parameterises both the free energy and the generalised transport operator governing the evolution of the material state, while enforcing material objectivity, energy balance, and non-negative dissipation as hard, scalable constraints. Analytical benchmarks involving simple stress-strain loading paths demonstrate that the method learns thermodynamically consistent and robust constitutive models for a range of inelastic materials of increasing complexity. At inference, the resulting models generalise to more demanding, unobserved paths and identify interpretable internal variables that capture path-dependent behaviours. The framework is then applied to granular media, prototypical heterogeneous and history-dependent materials. Trained on numerically simulated experiments based on the discrete element method, the method identifies admissible constitutive equations and predicts the response under cyclic loading, including the emergence of hysteresis absent from the training data, relying solely on macroscopic stress-strain histories.

中文摘要

arXiv:2409.15600v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：分子或材料的表示应当对物理对称性保持不变，且具有唯一性、连续性、高效性和通用性。然而，这些性质很难同时满足：在完整正交群 O(3) 下不变的描述符会赋予一个分子及其镜像相同的值，因此无法区分性质不同的对映异构体。Pozdnyakov 表明，这源于不变性本身，而不是参数不足。我们表明，如果几何映射按 O(3) 的符号特征进行分级，并以多重对称方式进行池化，则这些准则可以同时满足。我们构造了这样一个映射 Φ：其偶块通过 Gram 矩阵分解，并可证明对手性不敏感；而其由带符号三重积组成的奇偶性奇块，则能在相互作用构型的一个开稠密、满测度集合上区分对映异构体。唯一性的两个标准障碍——固定输出长度和逐分量池化——是池化规则造成的人为产物，可通过阶数至多为 N 的多重对称幂和来消除。我们为由距离矩阵、带符号体积和原子类型构成的完备描述符 Φ^star 建立了唯一性；在所有构型上，该描述符在 SE(3)×S_N 意义下是单射的。然而，Φ^star 是非构造性的；实际实现的映射是有界截断的 Φ，具有泛型单射性，采用 2 阶池化，运行复杂度为 O(N²)，或在使用邻居列表时为 O(N)。其代数核心已在 Lean 4 中进行了机器验证。由于其底层对象是一个胞腔复形，它还产生不变且稳定的拓扑特征 Ψ（持久同调和 Hodge–Laplacian 谱），用于编码有界截断描述符无法捕捉的全局环与笼状结构。成对的 (Φ,Ψ) 被输入一个紧凑的奇偶分级等变 Transformer。

English Abstract

arXiv:2409.15600v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A representation of a molecule or material should be invariant to the symmetries of physics, unique, continuous, efficient and general. These properties, however, are hard to satisfy at once: a descriptor invariant under the full orthogonal group O(3) gives a molecule and its mirror image the same value, and so cannot distinguish enantiomers whose properties differ. Pozdnyakov showed this follows from the invariance itself, not from a lack of parameters. We show the criteria can be met at once if the geometric map is graded by the sign character of O(3) and pooled multisymmetrically. We construct such a map Φ: its even block factors through the Gram matrix and is provably chirality-blind, while its parity-odd block of signed triple products separates enantiomers on an open dense full-measure set of interacting configurations. Two standard obstructions to uniqueness, fixed output length and componentwise pooling, are artifacts of the pooling rule, removed by multisymmetric power sums of order at most N. We establish uniqueness for a complete descriptor Φ^star built from the distance matrix, signed volumes and atom types, injective up to SE(3)× S_N on all configurations. Φ^star is non-constructive, however; the implemented map is the bounded-cutoff Φ, generically injective, pooling at order 2, running in O(N²⁾, or O(N) with neighbor lists. The algebraic core is machine-checked in Lean 4. Because the underlying object is a cell complex, it also yields invariant, stable topological features Ψ (persistent homology and a Hodge-Laplacian spectrum) encoding global ring and cage structure invisible to bounded-cutoff descriptors. The pair (Φ,Ψ) feeds a compact parity-graded equivariant transformer.

arXiv:2608.02119v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：尽管近期取得了进展，但预计未来几年量子计算机仍将具有足够高的噪声，以至于将量子化学计算限制在相对较少的轨道数上。然而，即便使用质量合理的单粒子基组，轨道数受限的小活性空间也会导致相当一部分相关能量的损失，这促使人们为量子算法设计中等质量、量子比特高效的基组。我们首先采用受遗传算法启发的方法，并结合激进的精炼策略，对现有最小基组进行重新优化，生成了从 H 到 F 各原子的修改后最小基组（MSTO-kG 基组；k = 2–11）。使用我们的 MSTO 基组在 FCI 理论水平下计算 H 到 F 的基态能量，得到的基态能量与 6-31G 基组得到的结果相当，有时甚至更低。对于 Li，MSTO 基组的性能优于 cc-pVQZ 基组。因此，与 STO 基组相比，在相同量子比特数下我们获得了更好的原子能量；与更高质量基组相比，则在更少量子比特下获得了更好或相当的能量。对于分子，H2 表现较差；这一发现与文献中的早期工作一致。对于其他分子 Li2、C2、LiH、BeH 和 BeH2，我们基组得到的 FCI 结果（C2 例外，采用 CISD）与 6-31G 基组的结果相当或更优。最后，我们比较了不同基组之间所需资源，发现 MSTO 基组在 VQE、QPE 和 HHL 中以更少的量子比特和双量子比特门数获得了优于竞争基组的能量。对于 QPE 和 HHL，所需的逻辑 T 门数也显著更低。总体而言，我们的工作为利用近期量子计算机开展更精确且对量子比特需求更低的量子化学计算铺平了道路。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02119v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In spite of recent advances, quantum computers are expected to be sufficiently noisy in the coming few years to the extent of limiting quantum chemical calculations to relatively small number of orbitals. However, even with reasonable quality single particle basis sets, small active spaces with limited orbitals can result in a significant fraction of correlation energy being lost, motivating the design of moderate quality qubit-efficient basis sets for quantum algorithms. We begin by reoptimizing the existing minimal basis sets using a genetic algorithm-inspired approach in conjunction with aggressive refinement strategies, and generate modified minimal basis sets (MSTO-kG basis; k = 2-11) for atoms from H through F. The ground state energies of H through F using our MSTO bases at FCI level of theory yield ground state energies that are comparable or sometimes even lower than those obtained using 6-31G basis sets. In the case of Li, the MSTO bases surpass the performance of cc-pVQZ bases. Thus, we obtain better atomic energies with same number of qubits relative to STO bases, and better/comparable energies with fewer qubits relative to higher quality bases. In the case of molecules, H2 performs poorly; a finding that is consistent with an earlier work in literature. For other molecules, Li2, C2, LiH, BeH and BeH2, the FCI results (except C2 for which we employ CISD) from our bases are comparable to/outperform those from 6-31G basis. Finally, we compare the resources required between different bases and find that MSTO bases yield better energies than the competing basis sets while incurring fewer qubits and two-qubit gates with VQE, QPE, and HHL. The logical T-gate counts are also found to be considerably lower for QPE and HHL respectively. Overall, our work paves way for more accurate yet less qubit-hungry quantum chemical calculations using near-term quantum computers.

arXiv:2608.00316v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：贝叶斯优化（BO）已成为样本高效优化的标准工具，其效率源于由通用统计先验驱动、具备不确定性感知的搜索。更丰富的领域先验原则上可以改进 BO，但通过定制核函数或问题结构来编码这些先验十分困难，且在实践中很少这样做。大语言模型（LLM）可以帮助绕过这一困难，使来自自然语言、代码和文档中的非正式先验可直接供优化器使用。然而，现有基于 LLM 的 BO 方法，要么将 LLM 置于固定角色中（作为代理模型、采集函数替身或配置接口），要么赋予其广泛控制权，从而牺牲了使 BO 可靠的系统性探索。我们提出 agentic Bayesian optimization：一种范式，其中 LLM 智能体在 BO 循环中充当核心决策者，而贝叶斯后端提供具备不确定性感知的优化基础设施。该智能体负责配置问题、查询后端、选择并确认评估，并且可以在运行过程中通过收紧边界、切换采集函数、提出有针对性的评估，甚至在接收到新指令或观察到证据后重新表述问题来修正优化策略。我们在 Sara 中实现了这一思想：这是一种结合代理模型增强的自动研究智能体；同时还实现了 lenz：一个模块化的、基于 BoTorch 的后端，智能体可通过结构化接口对其进行检查和修改。在合成与真实世界基准上，Sara 在没有先验知识的情况下保持了最先进 BO 的可靠性，优于基于 LLM 的基线方法，并利用自然语言先验将性能提升到标准 BO 之上。我们进一步展示了 agentic BO 在动态场景中的实际价值：当需求变化时，Sara 能够即时重新配置整个优化问题，这一能力在标准 BO 中此前并不可用。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard tool for sample-efficient optimization and owes its efficiency to uncertainty-aware search driven by generic statistical priors. Richer domain priors can improve BO in principle, but encoding them through tailored kernels or problem structure is difficult and rarely done in practice. LLMs can help sidestep this difficulty by making informal priors from natural language, code, and documentation directly available to the optimizer. However, existing LLM-based BO methods either insert the LLM into a fixed role (surrogate, acquisition proxy, or configuration interface) or hand it broad control, sacrificing the systematic exploration that makes BO reliable. We introduce agentic Bayesian optimization: a paradigm in which an LLM agent is the central decision maker in the BO loop while a Bayesian backend provides the uncertainty-aware optimization substrate. The agent configures the problem, queries the backend, selects and commits evaluations, and can revise the optimization strategy during the run by tightening bounds, switching acquisition functions, proposing targeted evaluations, or even reframing the problem following new instructions or observed evidence. We instantiate this idea in Sara, a surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent, and lenz, a modular BoTorch-based backend that the agent can inspect and modify through a structured interface. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, Sara preserves the reliability of state-of-the-art BO without prior knowledge, outperforms LLM-based baselines, and uses natural-language priors to improve beyond standard BO. We further demonstrate the practical value of agentic BO in dynamic settings, where Sara reconfigures the full optimization problem on the fly as requirements change, a capability not previously available in standard BO.

arXiv:2608.01626v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：短时降水临近预报对于水文气象早期预警至关重要，尤其是在强对流降雨可能引发城市内涝、山洪以及其他高影响灾害的情况下。面向预警的临近预报面临的一个关键挑战是：雷达降水场包含强耦合的多尺度结构，而预报质量往往会在较长预见期下降，使得在整个与预警相关的时间范围内保持强降水核心及其空间组织结构变得困难。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 QWRF-Net，一种用于短时降水临近预报的、结合校正流的量子小波框架。其核心思想是通过将潜在特征显式分解为小波子带来改进降水的条件表征，并在分解后的潜在空间中进行差异化的量子启发式调制，随后通过基于校正流的非自回归解码器生成未来序列。在统一评估协议下，基于 KNMI 雷达和 SEVIR 基准数据集的实验表明，QWRF-Net 取得了良好的总体性能，在中高降水阈值、极端事件子集以及保持强降水核心和精细尺度结构方面均获得了相对一致的提升。消融实验结果进一步表明，在所提出的框架中，基于小波的尺度解耦、差异化子带调制以及基于流的生成提供了互补性收益。总体而言，这些结果表明，联合增强多尺度降水表征和稳定的多步生成，是面向预警的短时降水临近预报中一个有前景的方向。观测到的改进也可能为下游水文和预警相关应用提供更有用的降水基础。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.01626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Short-term precipitation nowcasting is important for hydrometeorological early warning, especially when intense convective rainfall may trigger urban flooding, flash floods, and other high-impact hazards. A key challenge in warning-oriented nowcasting is that radar precipitation fields contain strongly coupled multi-scale structures, while forecast quality often degrades at later lead times, making it difficult to preserve intense precipitation cores and their spatial organization over the full warning-relevant horizon. To address this problem, we propose QWRF-Net, a quantum-wavelet framework with rectified flow for short-term precipitation nowcasting. The core idea is to improve the conditional representation of precipitation by explicitly decomposing latent features into wavelet sub-bands and then performing differentiated quantum-inspired modulation in the decomposed latent space, before generating future sequences through a rectified-flow-based non-autoregressive decoder. Experiments on the KNMI radar and SEVIR benchmarks under a unified evaluation protocol show that QWRF-Net achieves favorable overall performance, with relatively consistent gains at medium-to-high precipitation thresholds, on an extreme-event subset, and in preserving intense precipitation cores and fine-scale structures. Ablation results further indicate that wavelet-based scale disentanglement, differentiated sub-band modulation, and flow-based generation provide complementary benefits within the proposed framework. Overall, these results suggest that jointly enhancing multi-scale precipitation representation and stable multi-step generation is a promising direction for warning-oriented short-term precipitation nowcasting. The observed improvements may also provide a more useful precipitation basis for downstream hydrological and warning-related applications.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.00700v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展为解决 NP-hard 组合优化问题（COPs）的自动启发式设计（AHD）开辟了新途径。然而，现有的 LLM 驱动 AHD 方法大多局限于刚性的求解器模板，将搜索过程简化为孤立的模块调优。向完全自主、系统级的算法设计转变至关重要，但这一过程面临生成算子可靠性低、搜索空间极其庞大以及信用分配效果不佳等挑战。为克服这些缺陷，本文提出了一种有向图引导的自动算法设计框架，称为 DGA₂D。该框架将开放式程序空间构造成一个有向图，其中每个节点表示一个功能算子，并可由多个候选代码实现之一进行实例化，而有向遍历则构成完整的算法流水线。本文引入一种一阶路径依赖的信用分配机制，用于严格依据其拓扑上下文评估代码变体。在涵盖从复杂调度到路由等 12 个不同 COP 的大量实验中，DGA₂D 展现出稳定的实证优势。与最先进的 LLM 基线相比，其平均归一化差距最多降低了 10.96 个百分点。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00700v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened new avenues for Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). However, existing LLM-driven AHD methods are largely confined to rigid solver templates, relegating the search process to isolated module tuning. Transitioning to fully autonomous, system-level algorithm design is essential but fraught with low reliability of generated operators, extremely large search spaces, and ineffective credit assignment. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design framework, termed DGA₂D. It structures the open-ended program space as a directed graph, where each node represents a functional operator that can be instantiated using one of multiple candidate code implementations, while directed walks constitute complete algorithmic pipelines. A first-order path-dependent credit assignment mechanism is introduced to evaluate code variations strictly based on their topological context. Extensive experiments across 12 distinct COPs, ranging from complex scheduling to routing, demonstrate the consistent empirical advantages of DGA₂D. It reduces the average normalized gap by up to 10.96 percentage points compared to state-of-the-art LLM baselines.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.00711v1 公布类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被部署于科学研究中，在这一场景下，可靠性至关重要，且底层知识高度相互关联。在此类环境中，幻觉尤为有害：关于基础概念的一条错误陈述就可能沿多步推理传播，并污染整个推理轨迹。现有幻觉基准大多停留在表层，将事实孤立处理，并依赖忽视这种拓扑结构的统一准确率指标。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 SCHEMA，这是首个面向科学智能体幻觉的、证据驱动且感知拓扑结构的评估框架。SCHEMA 通过基准种子和文献证据自动构建科学概念图，合成覆盖声明验证、多跳推理、开放式解释和实验代码生成的图约束任务，并通过两个互补诊断模块评估智能体：轨迹幻觉流水线通过拓扑加权严重度评分在大规模上审计中间推理，多智能体反事实归因模块则精确定位特定失败背后的因果机制。SCHEMA 发现，幻觉集中于少数高度连接的知识枢纽，且最终答案准确率与轨迹诚实性相脱钩；模型往往通过结构上有缺陷的推理得到正确结论。这些结果表明，对于高风险科学应用，仅凭最终准确率不足以作为智能体可靠性的信号，这也凸显了以知识拓扑为基础、面向机制层面的评估之必要性。代码可见：https://github.com/circles-post/SCHEMA。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in scientific research, where reliability is critical and the underlying knowledge is densely interconnected. In such settings, hallucinations are particularly damaging: a single erroneous claim on a foundational concept can propagate through multi-step reasoning and corrupt entire trajectories. Existing hallucination benchmarks largely operate at the surface level, treating facts in isolation and relying on uniform accuracy metrics that ignore this topological structure. We address this gap with SCHEMA, the first evidence-grounded, topology-aware evaluation framework for hallucinations in scientific agents. SCHEMA automatically constructs scientific concept graphs from benchmark seeds and literature evidence, synthesizes graph-grounded tasks spanning claim verification, multi-hop reasoning, open-ended explanation, and experimental code generation, and evaluates agents with two complementary diagnostics. A trajectory hallucination pipeline audits intermediate reasoning at scale via a topology-weighted severity score, while a multi-agent counterfactual attribution module pinpoints the causal mechanism behind selected failures. SCHEMA reveals that hallucinations concentrate at a small set of highly connected knowledge hubs, and that final-answer accuracy decouples from trajectory honesty; models often reach correct conclusions through structurally flawed reasoning. These results indicate that for high-stakes scientific applications, terminal accuracy alone is an insufficient signal of agent reliability, motivating mechanism-level evaluation grounded in knowledge topology. Code is available at https://github.com/circles-post/SCHEMA.

arXiv:2608.00891v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：大型语言模型使得从自然语言描述或图像生成可执行的计算机辅助设计（CAD）程序成为可能。然而，现有方法要么将建模过程表示为带有隐式依赖关系的后端特定顺序脚本，要么表示为静态几何体，这使得在不同 CAD 系统之间同时保留构造历史、稳定的拓扑引用以及特征级可编辑性变得困难。我们提出 CADIR，一种面向智能体的、用于 CAD 生成和跨后端编辑的可执行中间表示。CADIR 基于 OCP 构建于 OCCT 几何内核之上，提供显式的、可组合的建模操作以及细粒度的执行诊断。在程序执行过程中，CADIR 会在构造图中记录建模操作、参数依赖、约束和拓扑选择。为实现可靠的跨后端重建，我们引入几何签名匹配（Geometric Signature Matching），即使在参数变化和后端差异存在的情况下，仍可识别对应的边和面，从而使适配器能够在 FreeCAD、SolidWorks 和 Fusion 360 中重建原生可编辑的特征历史。在这一表示基础上，我们进一步提出一种用于文本和图像查询的构造图检索方法，支持全图和子图检索，使智能体能够利用完整模型及建模子结构。大量实验表明，CADIR 在几何保真度和执行可靠性方面均优于现有 CAD 表示；构造图检索可进一步提升模型生成质量；跨后端编辑则能够在多个 CAD 环境中实现可靠的模型重建以及重建后的编辑。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.00891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.

arXiv:2608.02365v1 公告类型：新
摘要：世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）将机器人动作预测与视频世界模型相结合。现有采用共享主干和 Transformer 混合结构的 WAM，通常将动作模块的深度与视频主干的深度绑定，从而带来显著的计算开销和较高的推理延迟。为解决这一限制，我们提出 Dock of Transformer（DoT），这是一种以视频为中心的设计原则，将预训练的视频 Transformer 视为表征枢纽，并通过对接接口连接轻量级输出头。这使得输出头设计更加灵活，同时能够直接访问主干各层的表征。随后，我们提出 Faster-WAM，这是 DoT 在 WAM 中的一个实例化方法，它将一个单层动作头对接到一个 30 层视频主干上。该对接接口融合来自所有视频层的键和值，并应用 RoPE 重对齐。无需额外的具身预训练，Faster-WAM 即可在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得具有竞争力的性能，并在 LIBERO-Plus 上展示出强大的分布外泛化能力。在我们的受控对比中，Faster-WAM 还实现了最低的端到端延迟，每次推理仅需 66.5 ms——相比 Fast-WAM 提速 3.2 倍。总体而言，这些结果表明，以视频为中心的 DoT 架构在支持灵活的任务特定输出头设计的同时，还能提供较低的推理延迟、强大的动作预测性能以及稳健的泛化能力。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.02365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple robot action prediction with video world models. Existing WAMs with shared-backbone and Mixture-of-Transformers designs generally tie the depth of the action module to that of the video backbone, resulting in substantial computational overhead and high inference latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Dock of Transformer (DoT), a video-centric design principle that treats a pretrained video Transformer as a representation hub and connects lightweight output-heads through docking interfaces. This enables flexible output-head design while providing direct access to representations from all layers of the backbone. We then introduce Faster-WAM, an instantiation of DoT for WAMs, which docks a single-layer action head onto a 30-layer video backbone. The docking interface fuses keys and values from all video layers and applies RoPE realignment. Without additional embodied pretraining, Faster-WAM achieves competitive performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 while demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus. Faster-WAM also achieves the lowest end-to-end latency in our controlled comparison, requiring only 66.5 ms per inference --- a (3.2×) speedup over Fast-WAM. Overall, these results demonstrate that the video-centric DoT architecture supports flexible task-specific head design while delivering low inference latency, strong action-prediction performance, and robust generalization.

中文摘要

我们提出一种从第一性原理到机器学习的多尺度方法，以研究电子激发 α-SiO₂ 中的超快晶格动力学。基于依赖电子温度的密度泛函理论（DFT）的从头算分子动力学（AIMD）被用于训练依赖电子温度的深度神经网络势（DNNP）。DNNP 的使用使得能够以接近 DFT 的精度，对含有数千个原子的大 α-SiO₂ 晶胞进行原子尺度建模。特别是，DNNP 使我们能够获得 α-SiO₂ 的准确声子能带结构，以及由电子温度突然升高所激发的 α-SiO₂ 分子动力学（MD）。随着电子温度 Tₑ 的升高，发现 α-SiO₂ 出现显著的晶格失稳，其证据包括违反弹性稳定性判据、明显的体积膨胀、体模量急剧降低，以及由于反键态占据导致的 Si-O 成键逐步弱化。根据电子和声子能带结构，我们估算了 Frohlich 耦合常数；该常数随 Tₑ 升高而降低，表明 α-SiO₂ 在较高电子温度下可能跨越到非极性相。Bader 电荷分析也证实了这一点。我们还提出，在 Tₑ > 2 eV 时，极性光学声子散射应受到强烈抑制。通过大晶胞 DNNP-MD 模拟，我们表明，在最初数百飞秒内，并未达到由 Maxwell-Boltzmann 分布所定义的良好热平衡。这一行为解释了 Tₑ 突然升高后动能温度的非单调平衡过程。当 Tₑ 升高至 2.6 eV 后，Si 原子和 O 原子首先分别在两个不同温度下达到平衡，这表明存在一种原子流体相，与近期实验和理论发现一致。

English Abstract

arXiv:2607.28838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a multiscale first-principles-to-machine-learning approach to investigate ultrafast lattice dynamics in electronically excited α-SiO₂. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) based on electronic-temperature-dependent density functional theory (DFT) are used to train electronic-temperature-dependent deep neural network potentials (DNNPs). The use of DNNPs enables atomistic modeling at near-DFT accuracy of large α-SiO₂ cells with thousands of atoms. In particular, DNNPs allowed us to obtain accurate phonon band structures and molecular dynamics (MD) of α-SiO₂ excited by a sudden increase in electronic temperature. With increasing electronic temperature, Tₑ, pronounced lattice destabilization of α-SiO₂ is found, as evidenced by violations of elastic stability criteria, substantial volumetric expansion, a sharp reduction of the bulk modulus, and progressive weakening of Si-O bonding due to antibonding-state occupation. From the electronic and phonon band structures, we estimated the Frohlich coupling constant, which decreases as Tₑ increases, suggesting a crossover to a nonpolar phase of α-SiO₂ at elevated electronic temperature. This is corroborated by the Bader charge analysis. We also suggest that polar optical phonon scattering should be strongly suppressed at Tₑ > 2 eV. From large-cell DNNP-MD simulations, we show that a well-defined thermal equilibrium, as defined by the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, is not achieved over the first few hundred femtoseconds. This behavior explains the non-monotonic equilibration of the kinetic temperature after a sudden rise of Tₑ. After Tₑ is raised to 2.6 eV, Si and O atoms first equilibrate separately at two different temperatures, suggesting an atomic fluid phase, in agreement with recent experimental and theoretical findings.
